NAME: Bob
TEXT: Meet Bob 🐾 Introducing Bob, a gentle, affectionate greyhound with a heart full of love and a calm, easy-going nature. Bob is the kind of companion who doesn’t need much – just a quiet home, some treats, and a loving human (or two) to call his own. Bob is friendly with other dogs, cat-tolerant, and would do well in a home with older, respectful children. His gentle demeanour and soft, soulful eyes make him a peaceful presence, and he’s happiest when surrounded by the people he loves. This sweet boy has so much affection to give and loves nothing more than being close to his human family. He’s more than happy to chill out for most of the day, watching the world go by from a comfy spot in the house, or curling up next to you for some quiet company. Bob isn’t looking for adventure – just a calm, loving home where he can feel safe, relaxed, and cherished. If you’re after a loyal companion who will bring peace, love, and gentle tail wags into your life, Bob might just be the perfect match. He’s ready to settle down and soak up all the love his forever family has to offer – could that be you?

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Meet Roy 🐶 Say hello to Roy, a calm and affectionate greyhound who's ready to find his forever home. With his sweet nature and gentle personality, Roy is the kind of companion who will quietly steal your heart – and your couch! Roy loves a peaceful lifestyle and would be happiest in a calm, relaxed home where he can take things at his own pace. He gets along beautifully with other dogs and is friendly with children, making him a lovely addition to a family or a quiet household looking for a gentle companion. Roy is also cat-tolerant, and, with a slow and careful introduction, he could live with a confident cat or even pocket pets. He’s a respectful boy who just needs a bit of time to adjust to new furry friends. On walks, Roy can be a little eager at first and might pull on the lead, but once he settles in, he walks nicely and enjoys his outings without a fuss. At home, he’s calm, affectionate, and always up for a quiet cuddle or a nap in a sunny spot. If you're looking for a laid-back, loving greyhound who gets along with everyone and thrives in a peaceful environment, Roy could be the perfect fit. He’s ready to shower his forever family with quiet love and loyal companionship.

NAME: Nicko
TEXT: Meet Nicko 💤 🐾 Looking for a calm, low-maintenance companion to match your relaxed lifestyle? Nicko might be your perfect match. This laid-back greyhound boy is the definition of cool, calm, and collected. With his gentle nature and love for the quiet life, Nicko would thrive in a peaceful home with someone who enjoys a slower pace and values the joy of simple companionship. Nicko is incredibly relaxed around other dogs and enjoys the company of canine friends. He’s also shown a calm curiosity around children, making him a lovely addition to a home with respectful kids who understand his mellow vibe. And here's a bonus – Nicko could live with a cat! With a careful and slow introduction, he may adapt well to a feline housemate, making him a rare gem in the greyhound world. Nicko isn't the type to demand constant attention or high-energy adventures – a comfy bed, a few gentle walks, and the quiet presence of his human(s) is all he needs to be content. He’s ideal for someone who works from home, is retired, or simply prefers the comfort of a more peaceful routine. If you’re ready to share your life with a sweet, chilled-out greyhound who just wants to be near you and enjoy the calm moments, Nicko is waiting to meet you.

NAME: Emma
TEXT: Meet Emma 🐾 Say hello to Emma, a gentle, affectionate, and quietly charming greyhound with a heart full of love. With her graceful presence and calm nature, Emma is the kind of dog who quickly becomes the heart of any home. She loves nothing more than spending time with her people – whether that’s relaxing on the couch, following you around the house, or just being nearby while you work or unwind. Emma walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys her daily strolls, especially when she gets to catch up with her greyhound friends. She’s well-mannered around other medium to large dogs and has a calm, friendly way about her that makes her easy to get along with. Emma is also great with children and would be a wonderful companion for a family or a household with visiting grandkids. While she’s happy to snooze the day away in true greyhound fashion, Emma does best when she has company. She would thrive in a home where someone is around most of the time – whether you work part-time or from home, Emma will be your loyal and loving sidekick. If you’re looking for a gentle soul with lots of love to give, Emma is ready to steal your heart and become your new best friend.

NAME: Arthur (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *I'm currently in a foster home* And I say HEY! What a wonderful kind of day. If you can learn to work and play and get along with Arthur the greyhound! Arthur is a total cutie pie. He is the star of the show, much like the 90's show! He is a shy boy at heart, but loves smooches and cuddles once you get to know him. A backyard or courtyard would be suitable but he can also live in an apartment home as he enjoys settling quietly indoors and can do stair cases. He walks on a loose lead, as well as learning some training cues like 'on your bed' and 'off your bed'... Talk about talented! It's a simple message and it comes from the heart, Believe in this (and in Arthur the greyhound) for that's the place to start! Arthur is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: JoJo
TEXT: Meet Jojo! This lovely little lady is small (23kg) and shorter in stature without the long legs and is as sweet and charming as they come. Jojo is a relaxed, easy-going girl who’s just as happy doing zoomies in the backyard as she is snuggling up on the couch for a cozy night in. She loves playing with other dogs, enjoys trips to the dog park for a run, and gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes and sexes. Jojo is also wonderful with children 5-7+ and even cats, making her the perfect all-round family companion. Racing wasn’t for Jojo – she knew the pet life was made for her, and now she’s ready to find her forever home filled with love, cuddles, and fun. 💖💖💖

NAME: Ringo
TEXT: Ringo is a beautiful natured red fawn boy who has has a special spot in the family home, where he has been living on and off with other retired greyhounds (female), a Jack Russell, chihuahua, 2 cats, a 4-year-old and 8- year-old. Ringo is house-trained, very clean, he enjoys a walk but loves lounging on the bed the most, he's an easy going loving dog who is great with kids and all people. He might prefer a female owner seeing as she has been spoiled by his 'mum' all his life. He loves going to maccas for an ice-cream or cheeseburger as a treat, he also enjoys going to the dog park, a walk or just a car ride as he is an excellent traveller and adventures await! Ringo does prefer to be inside over outside, he hates being outside at night so would need an indoor home. He will make someone a very happy person. 🥰

NAME: Jenny
TEXT: Meet Jenny ⚡ Jenny is a vibrant, high-energy greyhound who’s full of life and always ready for fun! If you love a dog who keeps you entertained with endless zoomies and playful antics, Jenny is your girl. She has a confident and bold personality, and she’s not shy about letting you know what she wants—especially when it comes to snacks! She’s definitely a bit of a mischievous snack stealer who knows how to keep life interesting. Because of her spirited nature, Jenny will do best in a home with a strong, experienced owner who understands her confident personality and can provide her with the structure and guidance she needs. She thrives when given plenty of exercise and mental stimulation, so an active family who loves adventures and playtime will be a perfect fit. But don’t let her energetic side fool you, Jenny is also a truly sweet and affectionate girl. She loves nothing more than curling up for some quality cuddle time after a day full of play. Jenny is great with other dogs and even cats, making her a wonderful companion in a multi-pet household. Jenny is looking for a forever home that can match her enthusiasm and provide her with all the love and care she deserves. If you’re ready for a confident, lively, and loving dog who will bring excitement and joy to your life every single day, Jenny just might be the perfect fit!

NAME: Kenzie
TEXT: Meet Kenzie 🐾 Kenzie is a sweet and gentle girl with a heart full of love, though she’s a bit on the timid side. Because of her shy nature, she would do best in a calm, quiet home with older kids who understand and respect her gentle spirit. Kenzie isn’t one to jump into new situations quickly, but once she feels safe, her true personality begins to shine. She absolutely adores playing with her cuddly toy—watching her wag her happy tail as she tosses it around is sure to bring a smile to your face! Kenzie is a social little lady too; she gets along wonderfully with both cats and other dogs, making her a perfect fit for a multi-pet household. While she may start off shy, she always musters the courage to come say hi and make a sweet connection. Kenzie is patiently waiting for her forever family, where she can blossom and grow in confidence. With a little time, patience, and lots of love, she’ll become the loyal and affectionate companion you’ve been dreaming of. If you’re looking for a loving, gentle soul to share your life with, Kenzie could be your perfect match!

NAME: Tarnie
TEXT: Meet Tarnie! 🐾 Tarnie is a stunning girl with a heart as big as her soulful eyes. She’s known for her super sweet nature and gentle demeanour, making her an absolute delight to be around. Tarnie is wonderfully friendly with both cats and dogs, so she’s a great fit for homes with other furry family members. One of Tarnie’s greatest loves is children—she’s happy to play and interact with little ones, showing patience and kindness that makes her a wonderful companion for families. At the same time, Tarnie knows how to take things at her own pace and enjoy some quiet, independent time whenever she feels like it. She’s a smart girl who walks beautifully on the lead, turning every walk into a relaxing and enjoyable adventure for her and her humans. Whether it’s playtime, cuddle time, or just hanging out, Tarnie adapts easily and would suit a variety of households, from busy family homes to quieter ones. If you’re looking for a loving, gentle, and easy-going friend who will bring warmth and happiness into your life, Tarnie could be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Riley
TEXT: Meet Riley 🐾 Say hello to Riley, a gorgeous girl with a heart as big as her smile! Bursting with confidence and a zest for life, Riley is the kind of dog who adapts beautifully to just about any home – whether it’s a bustling family household or a quieter space with a solo human or two. Riley is the full package: cat-friendly, dog-friendly, and full of that easy-going greyhound grace we all adore. She's relaxed at home, happy to lounge around and soak up the love, but don’t let her chill side fool you – Riley absolutely loves to explore! Whether it's a walk through the neighbourhood or a new scent trail in the backyard, this girl is always ready for a little adventure. With her naturally happy nature and calm confidence, Riley would thrive in most households. She’s the kind of companion who will slot right into your routine, shower you with affection, and make every day a little brighter. Looking for a sweet, social, and steady best friend? Riley might just be your perfect match. 💕

NAME: Zeus
TEXT: Introducing Zeus; the God of sky and thunder. Ok so he may not be the famous ancient God, but his boy certainly is a wonder of his own. Zeus is a sweet, outgoing and confident gentleman. He will play bow at you and loves a good zoomie! He has shown to cope well by himself making him ok for a full time working household with a townhouse yard or full backyard. He would love a life of daily walks, interactive games and a family who likes training as he has shown to love learning new things here, he can even do the staircase (a big deal for greyhounds!). Zeus would enjoy a home with another dog his size and older children. If you’re looking for a sweet, silly, and social companion, Zeus is ready to steal your heart (and maybe your couch!). Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Godfrey
TEXT: Meet Godfrey 🐾💙 Say hello to Godfrey, the most distinguished gentleman in the greyhound world! With his irresistibly cute Roman nose and soulful eyes, Godfrey is a total heart-stealer who’s ready to find his forever couch – ideally one he can share with a canine companion. This easy-going boy has truly mastered the art of balance: he’s just as happy chilling at home with his humans as he is trotting around the neighbourhood, taking in all the sights and smells. A total dream on the lead, Godfrey walks loosely and politely, making strolls a breeze. He’s super social, loves a good cuddle, and would thrive in a home with another calm, friendly dog to pal around with. Godfrey’s gentle nature and laid-back vibe make him the perfect addition to a relaxed, loving household. If you’re after a loyal, low-maintenance best friend who brings charm, cuddles, and a touch of Roman elegance to your life, Godfrey might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! 🐾🌟 Charlie is a gentle, slightly reserved greyhound who quickly warms up once he feels settled and safe. This calm and affectionate boy enjoys exploring the world through his nose, taking in all the smells and sights on his sniffing adventures. Charlie thrives on companionship and would be happiest in a home where he can be part of the family’s daily life. He’s great with other dogs and cats, making him an ideal addition to a multi-pet household. Charlie’s easy-going nature means he adapts well to new environments, especially with a little patience and time to adjust. Charlie would do best in a home where he isn’t left alone for long periods. He loves having company, whether that’s a family with kids to keep him entertained or someone who works from home or part-time, so he never feels lonely. If you’re looking for a sweet, adaptable companion who loves to explore and enjoys the company of both humans and other pets, Charlie is ready to be your loyal friend. Charlie would be most suited to: A multi-pet household with dogs and/or cats A family environment with children who can provide gentle companionship A home where someone is present part-time or works from home An owner or family willing to give him time and patience to settle in A calm and loving environment where he can enjoy daily sniffing adventures and relaxed walks If Charlie sounds like your perfect match, do not hesitate to come and meet him!

NAME: Scarlette
TEXT: Meet Scarlett!🐾❤️ Scarlett is a joyful girl with a bright and confident personality that lights up any room she enters. She’s a social sweetheart who gets along wonderfully with all dogs and even likes cats, making her a fantastic fit for a multi-pet household. This happy girl would thrive in a loving family environment where she can enjoy plenty of company and affection. Scarlett’s confident nature means she’s comfortable exploring new places and meeting new friends, whether they have two legs or four. While Scarlett is a great walker overall, she could benefit from a bit of training on the lead to help her become an even better walking companion. With some patience and positive reinforcement, she’ll master those walks in no time! If you’re looking for a cheerful, adaptable greyhound who’ll bring joy and companionship to your family, Scarlett might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris🐾🌟 Boris is a sweet-natured boy with a calm heart and a curious spirit. He loves the company of other dogs, especially those larger in size, and enjoys the comfort and companionship of furry friends by his side. While Boris has a wonderfully gentle personality, he thrives best in an active lifestyle that keeps his mind and body engaged. He benefits from plenty of enrichment—whether that’s long walks, sniffing new trails, or interactive toys to keep him stimulated. Boris may take a little longer to settle into a new home, as he adjusts carefully to his surroundings. But once he feels comfortable, he truly blossoms into a confident and happy companion who loves to explore and soak up every moment of life. Because of his settling-in time and enrichment needs, an experienced greyhound owner may be preferred to help Boris thrive in his new environment. If you’re ready to welcome a patient, loving greyhound who will flourish with your time, attention, and active spirit, Boris could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Archie
TEXT: Meet Archie 🐾 ✨ Archie is a truly wonderful boy with a heart full of social spirit and a calm, confident nature. He absolutely adores spending time with other greyhounds and is happiest when he has a canine buddy by his side. Archie is great with medium to large dogs and fits perfectly into a multi-dog home where he can enjoy plenty of furry company. But it’s not just other dogs that Archie loves — he’s incredibly social and affectionate with people too! Archie thrives on human interaction and is always eager to make new friends, whether it’s a quick pat or some relaxed downtime together. His easy-going temperament means he’s not phased by much — busy environments, new places, or changes in routine don’t rattle this laid-back boy. Archie would do well in a home with older children who understand how to respect boundaries and enjoy gentle play. His calm and steady demeanour makes him a wonderful companion for families, singles, or anyone looking for a loyal, loving dog who’s ready to be part of the family. If you want a confident, friendly, and adaptable greyhound who gets along with both dogs and humans alike, Archie is the perfect match!

NAME: Liv
TEXT: Meet Liv 💕🐾 Say hello to Liv, a stunning senior greyhound with a heart as soft as her silky coat. This beautiful girl is the perfect blend of grace, affection, and gentle confidence. Liv has a calm, loving nature that shines through in everything she does. She’s a social butterfly who gets along with dogs of all shapes and sizes – from towering Great Danes to tiny Chihuahuas (yes, she’s been best buds with one!). She especially loves being around her fellow greyhounds, often sharing space and snuggles without a fuss. Despite her age, Liv is still full of quiet confidence. She hops in and out of her crate with ease, walks beautifully on the lead, and handles new situations with calm curiosity. She’s not clingy, but she absolutely adores affection – lean in close, and you’ll be rewarded with the gentlest of nuzzles. Liv is also toilet trained! If you're looking for a graceful companion who brings warmth, beauty, and peaceful companionship into your life, Liv is ready to be your girl.

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: Ryan has spent time in a foster home - keep reading to find out why his foster dad loves him! "Ryan is a sweet, gentle soul with the calmest nature you’ll ever meet. He loves lounging near you quietly, always happy to just be in your presence. He walks beautifully on the lead, gets along well with people, and has such expressive eyes that tell you exactly how he’s feeling. He’s low-maintenance, clean, and well-behaved around the house. He enjoys short walks and long naps, and has a soft spot for comfy bedding and gentle pats. While I’ve come to care for him deeply, I’ve realised I’m not quite ready for a dog at this stage. Ryan deserves a home where he can be someone’s forever companion. He’ll make an incredible addition to any calm, loving household." Ryan would suit a full-time working family, with a backyard. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would also suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan has conquered the Richmond main drag (pictured!). Did we mention he's super smart, too? He knows 'on your bed', down & shake among many other – he loves training so an owner who likes to engage in training would be a perfect match! Ryan is waiting here for you at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Stoker
TEXT: Looking for a Greyhound full of charm, confidence, and a love for affection? Meet Stoker! Stoker is a friendly girl who loves all the humans she's met while she's out and about! She absolutely adores pats and is super affectionate. Whether it's a quiet evening snoozing or a stroll around the block, she’s happy just being by your side. Stoker wouldn't mind sharing her new home with another medium to large dog, and she might even be happy with a smaller canine companion, pending a meet and greet. Stoker could be the perfect addition to your family! Meet her at Western Sydney.

NAME: Dream
TEXT: Meet Dream 🐾 Dream is a stunning girl with a heart as big as her beautiful smile. She’s a social butterfly who loves making friends and gets along wonderfully with dogs of all sizes—small, medium, or large. Dream is relaxed around cats and tends to happily ignore them, making her a fantastic fit for multi-pet households. She adores children and would flourish in a family environment where she can share her gentle, loving nature. This sweet girl has so much love to give and truly enjoys receiving lots of cuddles and pats. Dream thrives on affection and companionship and is happiest when she’s surrounded by people who appreciate her calm and affectionate spirit. Dream would be well suited to households that: · Have multiple pets, including dogs and cats · Include children of all ages · Prefer a friendly, social dog who enjoys company · Can provide plenty of cuddles, pats, and love If you’re looking for a loving, happy greyhound to bring warmth and joy into your home, Dream is ready to become your new best friend.

NAME: Lou Lou
TEXT: Meet Lou Lou 🐾 Lou Lou is a happy-go-lucky girl with a tail that’s almost always wagging—she’s a true bundle of joy and energy! Her playful and excitable nature means she’s always up for fun, games, and making new friends wherever she goes. Lou Lou truly shines in multi-pet households. She gets along beautifully with other dogs and has a special fondness for cats too, making her an ideal addition to a busy, loving home with lots of furry companions. Her friendly and gentle nature also makes her a fantastic companion for children, who she loves to engage with through play and affection. Despite her lively spirit, Lou Lou knows how to relax and enjoy quiet family time, curling up with her loved ones after a day full of adventure. She’s a social butterfly who thrives on companionship and loves being involved in all the family’s activities. Whether she’s chasing toys, making new friends at the park, or simply wagging her tail at the door waiting for you to come home, Lou Lou’s cheerful personality lights up every room she enters. She’s the perfect family dog, ready to bring happiness, laughter, and unconditional love into a forever home. If you’re looking for a joyful, loving, and playful companion who’s great with pets and people alike, Lou Lou is the one for you!

NAME: Mouse
TEXT: Meet Mouse 🐾 Mouse is a lovely, older girl with a calm and easy-going nature that makes her truly special. Despite being a mature lady, she still enjoys her daily activities and remains active and lively in her own gentle way. She’s incredibly friendly and gets along beautifully with other dogs—especially her greyhound pals—and is also cat-friendly, making her a wonderful addition to a multi-pet household. Mouse would do best in a low-key, peaceful home where she can relax and enjoy a steady routine. She would suit families with children who understand and appreciate her laid-back, loving temperament. With her sweet, mellow personality and affectionate spirit, Mouse is ready to share her calm companionship and gentle love with a forever family who will cherish her for the wonderful old girl she is.

NAME: Maggie
TEXT: Meet Maggie 🐾 Maggie is a gorgeous greyhound with a calm, loving nature and a heart full of affection. She gets along brilliantly with all dogs – her previous best friend was a lively Jack Russell, and she especially adores the company of other greyhounds. Maggie is a relaxed girl who takes everything in her stride. She walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys a gentle stroll just as much as a cosy nap in a sunny spot. She loves being around children and is happiest when surrounded by people who enjoy her quiet, sweet company. Maggie would be absolutely suitable for families and would also be stable for full-time workers who can offer her quality time and companionship. Plus, she’s a big fan of her toys and loves to play and chew happily. Whether she’s making friends at the park, playing with her toys, or snuggling up for cuddles at home, Maggie is the perfect mix of calm, sociable, and affectionate. She’s ready to share her love – and her couch – with a forever family who’ll cherish her gentle soul.

NAME: Cuddles
TEXT: Cuddles is a very affectionate and social girl, she gets on with everyone she meets and would make a great companion. She is great on the lead and very confident and content by nature. She would suit almost any environment given how laid back and confident she is.

NAME: Izzy
TEXT: Izzy is a beautiful hound who is very content and relaxed. She comes when called, she is extremely affectionate and is also a great walking buddy. She is great with the young puppies and social with all the other dogs, she has daily visits from native and domestic animals along with the local deer.

NAME: King
TEXT: King is a wonderful boy who likes to chase after toys and play. He has great recall and comes when called. He is a great companion and very affectionate. He has been living around a mixture of native and domestic animals.

NAME: Jason
TEXT: Meet Jason, a sweet guy with lots of personality, ready to find a place to call home! A home with a backyard or courtyard would best suit Jason, so he can do his zoomies or have a snooze in the sun. He can be a little shy at first but with a few scratches behind the ear and a couple treats, you'll win him over in no time! A home with adults or older children would be best for this guy, to help ease him into pet life. Jason gets along well with his Greyhound mates, so a home with another medium to large dog could work for him, pending a meet and greet. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Val
TEXT: Val is a cuddly and affectionate softie. He will love to be around you when your home and play with toys and love going for walks with you. He would make an excellent addition to the family.

NAME: Rosita
TEXT: Meet Rosita! Rosita is a gorgeous girl with a heart as big as her beautiful smile. She’s an incredibly happy and sociable soul who thrives on being part of the action. Whether it’s greeting new friends or joining in family activities, Rosita’s enthusiasm and friendly nature make her a joy to be around. She absolutely loves saying hello to everyone she meets — from little kids to fellow dogs and even cats! Rosita’s easy going and gentle temperament means she’s great with all sorts of household members. She’s been living harmoniously with cats and other dogs, and her patience and kindness around children make her a fantastic choice for families of all shapes and sizes. She’s also confident and has successfully managed a couple of stairs, showing her adaptability and eagerness to learn. One of Rosita’s standout qualities is how beautifully she walks on the leash. Calm, focused, and responsive, she makes daily walks a true pleasure. Whether you’re out for a gentle stroll or a bit more active adventure, Rosita is happy to keep pace and explore alongside you. All in all, Rosita would suit most households—whether you’re looking for a loving companion in a bustling family home or a calm presence in a quieter environment. She’s ready to bring joy, warmth, and plenty of tail wags to her forever family. Could that be with you?

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Rusty is a cute, snuggly guy who loves nothing more than leaning in for pats and cuddles. Food is definitely one of his favourite things, you’ll win his heart with treats in no time! He can be a little shy at first but with some time to settle him, Rusty will show you just how affectionate he is. Rusty would suit a home with adults or older children to help ease him into pet life. He also doesnt mind sharing his new space with another medium to large dog, pending a meet and greet. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving companion who’s ready to share snuggles and good times, Rusty might just be the perfect match! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Trixie
TEXT: *Trixie is in a foster care home in an apartment - reach out to the team to meet her!* Foster Update: "Trixie has been such a sweet girl, and her personality is really starting to shine these past few days. She’s so excited to go on walks, more focused on us rather than other people and dogs. So far we’ve been able to leave her overnight in her safe space downstairs with her bed and food, and she’s settled really well. During the day, we’ve been gradually building up her time alone, and she’s been fine for up to an hour to an hour and a half so far. When she met the greyhound in the park, she was very keen to say hi, so I think she would do well with other dogs. At the same time, she absolutely adores us, always leaning, cuddling, and rubbing against us. She’s thriving as a single pet at the moment and not showing any signs of being bored with just us in the house. She’s really come out of her shell!!! from calm and quiet to a sweet, excited girl. She wags her tail when she knows it’s time for a walk, and greets us happily every morning. She isn’t food-driven and doesn’t like many treats, though she loves a bit of cooked chicken. The only challenge has been stairs inside our apartment, she’s quite nervous about going up, we’ve been gently encouraging her and she’s now managing one or two steps on her own before retreating. I think Trixie would do well in a home with someone who can give her two walks a day — a short 20–30 minute one in the morning for the toilet and exercise, and a relaxed evening walk. She’s definitely a morning girl, happy to chill on the sofa during the day but also loves to cuddle, follow you around, and just be close. She’s a very sweet and happy girl." Trixie can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Tito
TEXT: If you're after a happy, friendly greyhound with a love for life, Tito is your guy! This cheerful boy is bursting with personality and with treats, toys and some love, his tail will always be wagging. Tito loves engaging with the new people he meets while he's out and about and wouldn't mind a home with older kids to match his playful spirit. He’d do best in a home with a backyard where he can have a play, do some zoomies or catch some rays ☀️ Tito may suit a home with another medium to large dog, pending a meet and greet to make sure it's the right fit for everyone! He’s also a star in the crate, happily munching on treats and chilling out. If you're ready for a life full of joy, play, and tail wags, Tito is the guy for you. Come and meet him at Western Sydney!

NAME: Kerry
TEXT: Little Kerry is in a foster care home! Read below to see how she's going... "The longest I've left her is 6-7 hours. She just sleeps on the sofa until I come home. She's a lot more curious about other dogs than she was in the beginning. She's ok when other dogs say hi on our walks. One dog growled at her and she didn't react. She's SO good with kids. Lots of them have asked to pat her and she loves it. She's really friendly. She loves humans in general and wants to say hi to all of them. I've had lots of different friends over and she's so relaxed with them. I think she'd be suited to any home as long as there's access to an outside space. Somewhere with grass would be good. Being matched with a couple or family or someone who works remotely would be best. I take her for 3 walks a day but she’s sort of just forced to sleep on the sofa otherwise so having some space to run around might make her happier. " Kerry is a petite black beauty at just 24kgs, with a soft, loving nature. She’s very friendly and easy going and LOVES children! If you’re looking for a sweet girl who has experience living in foster care with stairs, Kerry could be the perfect match. Kerry can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Jitter
TEXT: Meet Jitter 🌸 Say hello to Jitter, a beautiful senior lady with the softest eyes and the gentlest soul. She’s in her golden years and is now searching for the perfect place to enjoy the peaceful, loving retirement she so deeply deserves. Jitter is the definition of easy-going. She’s friendly, affectionate, and content to go with the flow. She’s fantastic with other dogs – big and small – and is also completely cat-friendly, making her a great fit for multi-pet homes. She’s also happy to share her space with children, as long as they’re the calm, gentle type who understand her love for quiet companionship. While Jitter enjoys affection – especially a soft pat and a warm cuddle – she’s also totally fine doing her own thing. She’s independent in the best way, happy to potter around the house or snooze in a comfy spot nearby while you go about your day. She doesn’t demand attention, but she’ll always be ready for a cuddle when you are. Jitter would thrive in a calm, relaxed household where she can enjoy the simple pleasures: soft beds, gentle hands, a quiet garden or sunny windowsill, and the company of people and pets who appreciate her peaceful energy. She’s not the type to bounce around or seek adventure – instead, she’s looking for a home filled with comfort, love, and understanding. Jitter is a low-maintenance, high-love kind of girl who will bring calm, comfort, and quiet joy to the right home. Let her spend her golden years knowing she’s truly loved.

NAME: Sharna
TEXT: Hi, I'm Sharna. I'm a friendly, happy girl who can't wait to meet you. I love my training and will do anything for a treat. I would be happy living along side another Medium-Large doggie pal pending a meet and greet, and would be happy to live with calm sensible children, too! I have spent time in the office and have learnt toilet training and don't mind if you pop out every now and then. If you have a house with a backyard I'd be suitable for full time hours as I love to sunbake, snooze and get a quick zoomie out! Come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Bambi
TEXT: Beautiful Bambi Bambi is a sweet, easy-going little girl with the loveliest gentle nature, a little shy at first with strangers but happy to come up to you once she's met you. She’s fantastic with children 3, 5 and 8 yrs, friendly with other greys and small dogs (poodle, Chihuahua, Jack Russell), and even gets along well with cats and chickens. Bambi is excellent inside, housetrained and crate-trained, not very energetic but likes an outing and walks nicely on lead. She is easy-care and with her lovely, cuddly, affectionate, soft-nature, truly the perfect family dog. 💖💖💖

NAME: Adal
TEXT: Adal – A Big Hunk of Love! Adal is a sweet, affectionate boy with a big heart and just as much love to give. He’s great with all people, always happy to see you, excitable at times and loves showering you with kisses. This easy-going lad enjoys his walks, car rides, playtime with his toys, and hanging out with his greyhound friends, as well as playing with the resident Whippet and Jack Russell. Adal isn’t a fan of storms, but he handles them well by quietly retreating to his safe spot inside on his bed or in a kennel in the garage until the weather passes. He’s not vocal, destructive, or escape-prone—he just likes to hunker down until it’s over. With his lovely nature, happy personality, and endless love to share, Adal will make a wonderful companion, especially if someone is home or close by if a storm is coming, and can be on his own or with another dog to play with.

NAME: Julie
TEXT: This sweet girl is a little shy to begin with but with some love and patience, she will warm up to you in no time! Julie would prefer a quiet home with adults or older children with some previous dog experience to help ease her into pet life. Once Julie warms up, she's full of bounce and loves to play! She loves toys and has responded well to her training at the centre. Julie would prefer a bit of space to have a run around or a snooze in the sun, so a house with a yard or courtyard would be best for her. Julie does well being a left alone, so with some time to settle in, could suit full or part time workers. She could go home with another medium to large dog, or even a smaller breed, pending a meet and greet to ensure its a good fit for everyone! Julie is available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet Blaze, a sweet guy looking for a place to call home. Blaze is a playful and affectionate guy, who with a bit of time to warm up will be your bestfriend! He loves his treats and has responded well to his training while here with us at the centre. He's loved his interactions with his greyhound buddies so could join a home with another medium to large breed dog, pending a meet and greet. He can tackle our training stairs with ease and could work up to being left a lone for longer periods of time. Blaze would prefer a home with adults or a family with adult children. Come down to Western Sydney to meet Blaze.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is the sweetest boy a heart full of love and legs built for adventure. This playful boy is looking for his forever home where he can shine as either your one-and-only or alongside another medium to large dog who matches his energy and style. 🐾 Personality & Temperament: Playful & affectionate – Jimmy loves to play and thrives on human interaction. Walk enthusiast – Walks are his favorite part of the day, and he’ll happily trot beside you rain or shine. Kid-friendly – Best suited to homes with older children who understand gentle dog manners. 🏡 Ideal Home: Jimmy would do best in a home where he’s either the only pet or paired with another dog of similar size. He’s not suited to living with small dogs or cats, but he’s got plenty of love to give to his human family.

NAME: Popeye
TEXT: Looking for a fun-loving Greyhound with lots of personality? Meet Popeye, a charming boy who’s equal parts confident and affectionate! Popeye walks beautifully on lead and enjoys exploring the world with confidence, even tackling full staircases like a pro! Popeye may be able to go home with another medium to large dog, pending a meet and greet. He’d thrive best in a home without young children, perhaps a home with adults or older children could be where he finds his new home. A small courtyard or backyard would be ideal, as he loves to show his playful side with a zoom around the yard. Popeye is affectionate, playful, and has loads of love to share. If you're ready for a goofy, loyal companion who’ll keep you smiling, Popeye is your guy! Meet him at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bluey
TEXT: *Hello! I'm in a foster care home! You can chat to the Western Sydney team to find out more!* Bluey is a super friendly, confident guy who is eager to bring a bit of fun and lots of love to his new home. Bluey has shown to get along well with his Greyhound mates, so a home with another medium to large dog could work for him, pending a meet and greet with his potential new companion. This guy also does well indoors and has shown his ability to confidently tackle stairs while with us here at the centre, so with some time to settle in and a chance to learn a new routine, a unit or apartment could be just where Bluey finds his forever home. Bluey enjoys having a play, and loves his toys but can get a little excited so it would best for him to be in a home with adults or older children. Bluey is available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Smoke
TEXT: Smoke is a beautiful affectionate boy. He is happy to lounge around and come in for a cuddle. Smoke has nothing to prove - he knows he is awesome. This big content cuddle machine would suit most households as he is confident, relaxed and gets along with everyone.

NAME: Mindy
TEXT: Mindy is a little shy at first, but with a chance to warm up, she'll be showing you her goofy side in no time! Mindy would best suit a quiet home, with adults or older children to ease her into pet life. Although Mindy has been appropriate during her interactions with other dogs of all sizes, she would prefer to be the only dog in her new home, so she can have all the love to herself. Mindy loves a treat and has proven to be a real smarty pants, learning "down", "touch" and "shake" on cue! She has shown to settle well when left alone and while indoors, but would prefer a home with a yard or courtyard to have a play or a snooze. Full time or part time workers may work for Mindy, she will just need a chance to build up to longer hours alone. Come down and meet Mindy at Western Sydney!

NAME: Milly
TEXT: Meet Milly! A happy, bubbly girl who cant wait to bring some fun and love into your life. Milly has spent some time in foster care, where she settled in wonderfully. She was excellent with her toileting habits and had no accidents indoors during her time in foster which means a unit or apartment set up could be the perfect place for her. She's confident with our training stairs here at the centre, but may just need some guidance from her new family when tackling larger flights (a treat should do the trick!) Milly would prefer to be the only dog in her new home, so she can bask in being the light of your life! And older kids or those with dog experience would be best for Milly. Meet her at Western Sydney!

NAME: Tiffany
TEXT: Full of fun and lots of love to give, Tiffany is ready to find a place to call home! This sweet girl is not just a pretty face, she has responded very well to her training whilst here at the centre and has wonderful lead manners. Whether it's having a play or catching rays, a house or townhouse would be best for Tiffany. A home with another medium to large dog could work for Tiff, she would just need to meet them first to make sure it's the right fit. Tiffany wouldn't mind a family home, but would be best with older kids to have a play with and someone home more often than not to help settle her into her new life. If you're looking for some love and fun in your life, Tiffany just might be your girl! Come and meet her at Western Sydney.

NAME: Allira
TEXT: Allira - Sweet, Gentle & Full of Personality Allira is a real sweetheart! A quiet little girl at first, but once she feels at home, her playful side shines through with joyful zoomies and cheeky bursts of energy. She even enjoys a game of chase with a five-year-old child before happily curling up for a well-earned rest. She gets along beautifully with cats, small dogs, a Kelpie, a Rottweiler, and other greyhounds, usually following them around. With her slight Roman nose – a touch of goddess charm – and her heart of gold, Allira is a perfect catch with her easy-going, easy-care, and easy-to-love nature. She would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a smaller, quiet girl who still has plenty of personality and love to share. 💘

NAME: Dasha
TEXT: Meet Dasha – the darling girl with a playful streak! Dasha is a loving, calm, and confident girl who brings just the right mix of fun and relaxation. She enjoys her morning zoomie, a walk during the day, and another burst of play in the evening – the rest of the time, she’s more than happy to lounge on the couch. She's a cuddly teddy bear! She’s great with little dogs, friendly with other greys, and would suit a family with kids 10+ or a companion home. Dasha is housetrained (she’ll let you know when she needs to go out!) and settles well on her own once comfortable. This chatty girl does have one funny quirk – a love for toilet paper – so keep your bathroom doors closed! With her gentle nature and sweet personality, Dasha will make a wonderful family pet or loving companion.💘

NAME: Meeka
TEXT: Meet Meeka – Your Sweet Senior Companion! Meeka is a lovely, gentle-hearted senior girl who has been living as a much-loved pet for the past couple of years. She’s fully housetrained and adores her special spot on the couch, where she can relax and keep you company. This quiet, soft-natured lady is wonderful with children (currently living happily with 5- and 7-year-olds), gets along well with cats, and is friendly with small dogs. She still enjoys a short walk or time outside soaking up some sun, playing with her toys and splashing in her shell pool or running under the sprinkler on a warm day. She’s an easy-care, friendly, loveable companion who is content spending some time on her own, with or without another dog. Meeka is looking for a calm, loving home where she can enjoy her golden years surrounded by warmth and affection, perfect for retirees or someone looking for company. 💟

NAME: Stanley
TEXT: Meet Stanley – The Blonde Bombshell! Stanley is a handsome young fawn boy with long, dangly legs and a goofy, cuddly nature. This absolute stunner loves to snuggle on the lounge, muck about, and be your best friend! He can be a little shy at first, but soon warms up to you. He’s a true gentleman—excellent with all dogs (big, small, male, or female), cat friendly, great with children 7+, and house trained. Stanley enjoys a daily walk but isn’t an energetic boy—more of an easy-going, easy-care lad who was never interested in racing. Stanley would make a wonderful companion for any loving household ready to give him the love, care and cuddles he is looking for in his forever home.💙

NAME: Fatty Nova
TEXT: Nova is a happy girl who likes children. She can get a little excited to start so good supervision is a must. Nova has been around small dogs, she was polite and playful and would suit a calm small short haired dog or medium to large breed friend Nova would love a family that she can curl up with on the couch and teach her to play ball Nova has spent a small amount of time in the house and adjusted well and is looking forward to finding her own home

NAME: Zara
TEXT: Zara is a chilled and easy going girl Zara would like a quiet home where she can chill with her family and perhaps go on a short walk every few days Zara has been living in a home and is quiet and easy to live with Zara has been socialised with small dogs and would be fine with a relaxed quiet small friend

NAME: Tippy
TEXT: Tippy loves people and would love a family who will spend time playign with her Tippy loves to chase the ball and will quickly learn to bring it back. Tippy likes all sorts of toys not just balls Tippy has met small dogs and was very well mannered Tippy is chilled and easy going as well as playful

NAME: Ricky
TEXT: Ricky is a playful exuberant boy who would benefit from an active family He would loves some teenage mates to hang with Loves to play ball Has met small dogs and was well mannered so would suit a home with a confident small dog Very clean and tidy in his kennel

NAME: Tago
TEXT: Tago is calm and gentle Tago has met and socialised with multiple breeds of dogs and is happy to interact but likes to just do his own thing Tago is a clean and quiet boy Tago has met a cat, but was too busy looking at his own reflection in the mirror to be bothered by her

NAME: George
TEXT: friendly and easy going George is a bit of a goof ball but a lovable goof George is polite and friendly with small dogs George has been socialised with children of all ages George has met a cat and was indifferent to it so may be suited to a confident, easy going indoor cat

NAME: Bingo
TEXT: With Bingo, you'll always be a winner! Meet Bingo, a confident, lovable guy, looking for a place to call home. He is super confident and loves to learn (he'll do anything for a treat). Bingo has been great with interactions with his greyhound mates so could suit a home with another medium to large breed companion, pending a meet and greet. Bingo has shown to do well indoors so a unit or townhouse setting could be where he finds his new home, he may just need some time to settle into his new life and routine. He has also demonstrated confidence on our training staircase but would need some supporting guidance from his new family to tackle more challenging flights. This should be a breeze given his love for treats and praise. Shout BINGO if you think he's the one!

NAME: Maggy
TEXT: Maggy is a sweet little darling brindle girl. She is friendly and loving and not very energetic, loves a snooze in the sun or splashing and lying in her shell pool on warm days. A little run and play in the garden with other retired greys and a couple of 9 month-old greyhound pups and a short walk is enough for the day. Maggy goes on street walks in a quiet neighbourhood, excited to meet strangers, though not used to meeting other breeds of dogs or cats. She has been living in kennels with other retired greys but would love the chance to live inside, especially in the winter months. Maggy is such an easy going, quiet and very friendly little girl (24kg), she will melt your heart when you see her. She has a cute little bob tail and still manages to wag her whole behind. She would suit a home with another greyhound or on her own with someone to spend some time with her or just potter about with you. She is a special, easy going girl looking for a loving and affectionate forever home 💖

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Meet Gorgeous Grace! Grace is a sweet and affectionate girl with a gentle nature that shines through every day. She adores spending time with children (she’s great with kids aged 6, 8, and 11) and gets along well with other dogs, including a dachshund and fellow retired greyhounds. Grace would love a family home where she can be part of the action - whether that’s playing in the yard, being groomed and enjoying cuddles on the couch, or joining in on daily life. Her favourite time is walks with the kids (can be walked by the 8 and 11 year old) and going to school pickups to get pats from the other kids and everyone she sees! She loves being inside and also happy outside for the day. She would suit a home with or without another dog, as long as she has plenty of love and companionship. Could Grace be the perfect new member of your family? 💖

NAME: Chase
TEXT: Chase is a young, friendly, and happy boy who loves a backyard for zoomies, daily walks, and a bit of playtime with his people. He’s cat-friendly, great with dogs big (female greys) and small (Jack Russells), even fine around birds. This easy-going handsome lad would suit a loving home where someone has time to guide his growth and share in his journey. Chase walks well on lead once he gets going (a bit excitable at first), isn’t bothered by traffic, and has lived inside, is housetrained, and used to everyday household noises. Suitable for a family with kid/s 10+. Chase is ready for his new adventure in life - and to become your loyal pal or much-loved family member!

NAME: Toby
TEXT: Toby is a handsome, dangly-legged young boy with a heart full of love! This smoochy lad is easy-going, walks beautifully on lead, and is great with children 6+, and medium to large dogs of either gender. He just prefers his space when it comes to small dogs and no cats. Toby would thrive in any home with a backyard and daily walks to stretch his legs . He’s still young but was never interested in racing, and apart from short bursts of energy each day, he’s a calm and relaxed companion who loves his toys, cuddles and to simply hang out with his humans inside and out. Another large dog would be good for canine company.

NAME: Rhys
TEXT: Rhys is a super affectionate boy and a true “leaner,” always ready for cuddles. He loves to play and even knows how to fetch – a rare talent for a greyhound! Rhys enjoys his walks and is always excited to meet new people along the way. He gets along well with other medium to large dogs, so with a successful meet and greet, he could happily share his home with a canine companion. While he’s shown he can settle well indoors, Rhys would love a home with a yard where he can stretch his legs, play, and bask in the sunshine. A household with adults or older children would be the perfect match for this handsome, playful boy. If you’re after a fun-loving companion with plenty of affection to give, Rhys is ready to steal your heart!

NAME: Snake
TEXT: *I have just gone to a foster care home - check in soon for updates!* Snake is a friendly, affectionate boy who’s ready to bring light and joy into his new home. He’s a clever lad who comes when called, loves his treats, and walks beautifully on lead, making outings a breeze. He has shown positive interactions with other Greyhounds and may be suited to living with another medium to large dog for company, pending a meet and greet. Confident, sweet, and handsome, Snake is eager to start his next chapter with a loving family. If you’re looking for a loyal companion with plenty of charm, Snake might just be the perfect match! Come down and meet Snake at Western Sydney!

NAME: Mikey
TEXT: Soft-hearted and affectionate, Mikey is wonderful with teenagers and thrives in a family setting. He’s happy to play during the day, cuddle at night, and wait patiently while you’re at work. Gentle, loyal, and always ready for a hug, Mikey is a boy who will quickly steal your heart.

NAME: Harper
TEXT: Meet Harper – your gentle, loving companion! Harper is a sweet, beautiful-natured little girl. At first she can be a little shy, but soon comes out of her shell & will shower you with affection. She is friendly and loves children 5+, a pat from a stranger or the vet and outings in the car, splashing in ponds, a shell pool or a nice warm hydrobath. She isn't over energetic, loves a walk but ok to miss a day or two. She loves the comforts of her bed at home! Harper gets along with dogs big and small and, once settled, she’s happy on her own – content to rest after her walk, snoozing on her bed or soaking up the sunshine outside. A small yard is fine for her during the day. Harper is a kind and gentle soul would would make a wonderful and loyal companion. 💖

NAME: Azzie
TEXT: Great with young children. Happy go lucky guy. Calm, friendly & sweet natured. Good with smaller breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle would be best. If you might consider welcoming two greyhounds into your home, Azi’s brother Arrie is also searching for his forever home :)

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Tilly has had good inside experience, she gets along great with other dogs. She likes to engage and play followed by some serious relaxing. She is soft and gentle with young kids and great company.

NAME: Tess
TEXT: Tess is a little angel with a beautiful, gentle nature. She’s a quiet girl who will need a bit of time to settle in at her own pace, but once she feels safe and comfortable, she’ll become your loyal shadow and best friend. She’s shown no interest in our resident cat, so with slow and careful introductions, she may be cat workable. Tess might also benefit from having a calm canine companion, but she’d prefer a relaxed dog rather than one with intense energy. Her ideal home is a quiet one, where she can truly relax and feel at ease. Tess loves nothing more than curling up on the lounge for a cuddle. While she enjoys her walks, she can get a little excited and may need some gentle guidance on the lead as she continues to learn. With a bit of patience and a lot of love, Tess will blossom into the most devoted and affectionate companion.

NAME: Bossy
TEXT: Bossy has spent some time in a home! See what they have to say below! "Having previously owned and fostered greyhounds. I can honestly say that Bossy is by far the most gentle and happy go lucky boy. Bossy is timid at first but I promise after a good couple of days, he easily becomes your little helper (following you to the bathroom & kitchen) and becomes a part of the furniture - lazing about beside you. Bossy is cheeky at times however learns extraordinary quickly and will cease any naughtiness immediately if you ask politely in a mild mannered tone. He is sometimes unsure on the lead, which is to be expected: scared of new people & unfamiliar noises, he seems fine getting up and close to a variety of dogs whilst directly by my side but he does seem to have a bit of a flight response with human beings. However over the past week and a half, he has proven he is extremely trainable. He just needs patience, a little guidance and a whole lot of love to build up his confidence and trust in his surroundings. He's favourite daily activities include; whole body hugs & head kisses, big belly rubs, tearing up a cardboard box then passing out asleep! Bossy is a gentle, sensitive soul who is looking for a calm and understanding home where he can feel safe and supported. He’s a shy boy who will take some time to build confidence, but with patience and consistency, his sweet nature will begin to shine through. While Bossy hasn’t lived inside full-time, he does have some experience being indoors and is already showing great house manners. He’s house trained and walks beautifully on lead, making him a lovely companion for someone after a quiet, easygoing dog. His chill, couch potato vibes mean he’s happiest in a relaxed environment and could potentially suit apartment living if it’s peaceful and predictable. Bossy has shown little interest in our resident cat, so he may be cat and small dog workable with slow and gentle introductions. He also seems comfortable being left alone for periods, which makes him quite adaptable once settled. With a soft bed, gentle guidance, and time to adjust, Bossy will make a calm and loyal addition to the right home.

NAME: Elly
TEXT: Elly is a bright, energetic greyhound with a big, happy personality that’s guaranteed to make you smile every day. She’s best suited to a home with an active lifestyle, where she can enjoy regular walks, plenty of enrichment, and space to unleash her pretty impressive zoomies. She currently lives with whippets and enjoys their company, so she'd likely benefit from having another doggo friend to play and relax with. Elly is small dog workable with slow and respectful introductions, and she’s learning her manners — she’s food motivated and already understands “no,” which makes her a great candidate for continued positive training. Despite her bursts of energy, Elly also knows how to switch off and chill out with her people. She’s affectionate, fun-loving, and full of character - the kind of dog who brings joy and laughter into every day.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Benji is a sweet and easygoing greyhound who would be the perfect match for someone with a semi-active lifestyle. He enjoys his walks and a good zoom around the yard, but he’s just as happy to curl up on the couch for a cuddle. More of a homebody at heart, Benji is a real people dog who thrives on companionship and being part of the household. He’s a big fan of toys and loves a play session, especially if it’s followed by some quality nap time. Benji walks well on lead and is great with kids, making him a lovely addition to a family environment. He currently lives happily with little whippets and may benefit from having another dog for company. With small dogs and cats, slow and careful introductions will be important, but he shows potential to adjust. A home with a backyard is a must for Benji so he can enjoy his zoomies and outdoor time. Overall, he’s a gentle, affectionate boy who just wants to be close to his people and enjoy the simple pleasures of life.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a vibrant and playful greyhound who’s full of life and always ready for the next adventure. He would thrive in an active home with a yard to run around in and older kids to keep him company. Bob is high on life, he loves his zoomies, enjoys playing with toys (his absolute favourite activity), and is always up for a cuddle once he’s had his fun. He walks well on lead and is very social, enjoying the company of people and other dogs. While he’s not a fan of cats, he might do well with a medium to small dog in the home, provided introductions are done slowly and with care. Bob travels beautifully in the car and takes everything in stride. He will need an experienced owner or someone patient and understanding, as he may take a little time to learn house manners and settle into a routine. He’s smart, enthusiastic, and eager to please, he just needs the right guidance. Overall, Bob is just happy to be here. With the right family, he’s going to be an incredibly fun and loving companion.

NAME: Camo
TEXT: Camo is a sweet and gentle greyhound looking for a semi-quiet life with a family who can give him the balance of fun and relaxation he enjoys. He’s the kind of dog who’s happy with a walk, a good zoomie session, and then settling in for some cuddle time on the couch. He walks well on lead and enjoys getting out and about, but he’s not overly high energy. At home, he’s currently living with a Jack Russell and gets along well, so he should be fine with small dogs. He may benefit from having another dog in the home as a companion, but he could also settle as a solo dog with the right people around him. Camo is fine with kids and would be a lovely addition to a family. However, he is not cat workable, so a feline-free home is essential. Overall, Camo is a calm, affectionate boy who just wants a warm spot, some love, and a bit of fun in his day.

NAME: Zena
TEXT: Zena is a happy, friendly girl, who would suit a nurturing, calm household to really thrive into the cheeky confident girl we've seen here! A home without kids would support her confidence the best. She can live with another calm dog her size and loves to settle down in a cozy area, and does best indoors in a quiet room. A house with a backyard is best suited. This gorgeous girl has shown us her confident side by conquering our stair cases here! Zena is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: Shelby has been living with another greyhound, small dogs and cats in a home setting. Shelby is full of fun, loves to play with her toys and shows off her confidence when interacting with the new humans she meets. Shelby loves other dogs, showing her excitement for play and making friends when she meets other 4 legged friends. She even currently lives with a Jack Russell, so pending a meet and greet, could very well go home with a feline or canine bestie. Come down to Western Sydney to meet Shelby! She just might be exactly what you're looking for 🐾

NAME: Larry
TEXT: Larry is a beautifully nature boy who would make a great addition to any family. Larry is experienced around kids as young as 1 year old and is soft and gentle around them. Larry enjoys a play around the backyard and is fine with being left alone during the day whilst you work. Larry is crate trained overnight and settles into new environments seamlessly

NAME: Cleo
TEXT: Cleo is a gentle girl, with some experience with kids 6-16. Her favourite past time is indulging in a McDonalds soft serve ice cream, or playing with toys. Cleo has done some extra pet prep prior to meeting you, including going inside the house, meeting small dogs, birds, and more children! She's particularly well socialised around other greyhounds so a home with another dog would be a good fit. She's described as sensible, with a good food drive for training, as well as playful, but shy at first. Come meet Cleo at Western Sydney!

NAME: Gary
TEXT: Hey mate, the names Gary, good to meet ya! I am a lovely, happy boy, and pretty much a friend to everyone I've met. Everyone loves Gary, if I do say so myself! I'll wag my tail like crazy, probably do a zoomie, but I don't mind my down time too mate! I reckon I could get along with your dog if you've already got one at home, and even those little trouble makers at home, I figure kids would be great fun, more attention for ol' Gary! Give me a backyard or a townhouse and I'll make myself right at home. I might not have been a pet before but I have such a can do attitude, I'll fit in anywhere. Come meet Gaz at Western Sydney.

NAME: José
TEXT: Hi! I have just met you and I love you! I'm José, a friendly, confident boy, I love people, pats and attention! I hope you can see how full of love I am from my cute photos. I will put my head on you and ask for more pats! I'm a sweet guy who is good around other dogs, including mingling with small dogs at times. I don't mind chilling out in a crate but I don't need one! I'd love a backyard, a social life, adventures, and maybe even children to give me lots of pats and adoration, too! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Pat
TEXT: Hi, I'm Pat! I promise to be the bestest boy ever! I hope you like me too. I am a very friendly and affectionate boy. I love food and can be a little shy. I am called a lounge lizard by my current family. I've even done things like go to the beach, meet children, and see the sights on street walks. I don't really show much interest in toys but I have perfected the greyhound zoomie. A paddock gallop is my 'happy place'. I hope you have a backyard for me to chill out in! You can meet me and "Pat me" at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Xena
TEXT: Xena is a cheeky, gentle and fun little girl. She likes food, and engages nicely with new people once she warms up from being intially a bit shy. Xena lives with another greyhound at the moment so we think she'd do well in a multi-dog household. Older kids would enjoy her gentle yet curious and playful side. Xena has also done things like street walks, hanging out with children, and other socialisation, making her a great companion for families. Her family say nothing phases her! Xena is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Zac (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Zac is a lovely, friendly and confident boy. He has learnt lots about pet life prior to meeting you, including what crates are, the beach, swimming, hangoug out with children, social greetings with visitors to the house, and is very affectionate with people. Zac would be a great addition to a multi-dog household as he currently lives with another greyhound in a house setting. He's described as quiet and laid back, likes his treats and is gentle overall. Zac is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Brown Eyes
TEXT: Quiet, friendly and gentle boy Brown Eyes is a little on the shy side, we think he will warm up with your gentle touch! He shows gentle greetings with small dogs, greyhounds. He walks nicely on the lead out and about, travels well in cars and likes children! Brown Eyes is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Charmaine
TEXT: Charmaine or nickname Chaz is extremely affectionate and lovely to be around. She has a well balanced lifestyle of doing some morning zoomies or fetching toys followed by lounging around the yard. She is currently living the pet life in a suburban backyard around other dogs, enjoys neighbourhood walks and getting some inside experience (with no accidents).

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Meet Roy 🐾💛 Roy is a calm, sweet-natured boy who embodies peace, patience, and quiet joy. This handsome boy is happiest when he’s out and about with his doggy friends, peacefully roaming the yard or going on gentle adventures side by side. Roy gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes—from fellow greyhounds to the tiniest of pups—always showing kindness, curiosity, and a calm, friendly approach. He would absolutely love a home with a backyard where he can stretch his legs, sniff around, and enjoy the fresh air at his own pace. Roy isn't the kind of dog who needs constant activity—he’s more of a gentle wanderer who enjoys his freedom to explore, lounge, and take in the world around him. Roy’s love for humans is just as strong. He’s wonderful with children and has a peaceful, patient demeanour that makes him a safe and loving companion for families. He’s the kind of dog who fits right into the flow of family life—happy to be around people, share quiet time, or simply nap nearby while you go about your day. If you’re looking for a gentle soul to bring peace, love, and quiet joy into your life, Roy is more than ready to become your loyal companion.

NAME: Duffy
TEXT: Meet Duffy 🐾💙 Duffy is a happy-go-lucky male with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging. This friendly boy has a special knack for making friends wherever he goes—he absolutely adores other dogs, whether they’re fellow greyhounds or smaller pups. Duffy especially enjoys the company of female greyhounds and would be thrilled to share his new home with a canine companion to play and relax with. But Duffy’s friendliness doesn’t stop with dogs—he’s also wonderful with children, always eager to say hello and share a joyful moment with little ones. His gentle, playful nature makes him a fantastic family dog, and he thrives in environments where there’s plenty of love and laughter. Duffy is happiest when he has space to run and explore, so a home with a backyard would be the perfect place for him to stretch his legs and soak up the sun. When it’s time for a walk, Duffy shines—he walks beautifully on the lead, making every stroll a peaceful and enjoyable adventure for both him and his humans. Despite his playful spirit, Duffy is a calm and easy-going companion who just wants to bring happiness and affection to his new family. He’s a true social butterfly who loves being part of the action, whether it’s a fun play session with his furry friends, a gentle cuddle on the couch, or a sunny afternoon in the yard.

NAME: Zsa Zsa
TEXT: Zsa-Zsa is a quiet, sweet and playful girl. She is looking for a calm and quiet home, either an apartment or house. Her best suited family would be one without children, so she can enjoy the calm serenity of your home while she grows in confidence. She's a lover of treats and food and has grown in confidence here at the centre. She responds best to gentle encouragement, would be happy to live along side another calm and nurturing/older greyhound or Medium-Large doggie pal. She is confident with our training staircase and would suit shorter hours alone while she settles into her new life. She also settles in a crate, however not required. If you have a quiet home and neighbourhood and are looking for a gentle natured canine companion, Zsa-Zsa could be your perfect fit. She can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lukey
TEXT: Meet Lukey 🐾✨ Lukey is a friendly and affectionate male greyhound who’s already experienced the best of both worlds. Having lived inside a loving home, he’s well-socialized with other animals and absolutely adores people of all kinds. Lukey is a confident, happy boy who loves being out and about in the community—whether it’s a walk in the park, a visit to a café, or simply exploring new places, he takes it all in with a wagging tail and bright eyes. This easy-going guy thrives on affection and will happily shower you with love in return. Lukey’s calm and gentle nature makes him a fantastic companion, ready to settle into family life or enjoy the company of other pets. His experience living indoors means he’s well-behaved and adaptable, making him a smooth fit into homes big or small. If you’re looking for a loving, sociable, and happy-hearted greyhound who’s ready to be your loyal sidekick, Lukey is the perfect match. He’s excited to share his affectionate nature and joyful spirit with a forever family.

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal 👑🐾 Royal is a delightful girl who truly lives up to her name. She’s a playful and affectionate sweetheart who adores making friends—especially with other dogs, no matter their size! Royal’s favourite thing in the world is playing with her furry pals, and she’ll happily invite any dog she meets to join in on the fun. Whether it’s a game of chase, tug, or just a joyful romp, Royal is always ready to play. This gentle lady would make a wonderful family pet. She’s calm and confident, not easily stressed by new people or environments, which makes her adaptable and easygoing in all kinds of settings. Royal loves her toys and can spend hours happily entertaining herself or sharing playtime with her favourite humans. When she’s not busy playing or making new friends, Royal is a cuddle bug who loves to snuggle up and soak in all the love and attention she can get. She’s a perfect balance of lively and laid-back—a true joy to have around. If you’re looking for a loving, playful, and incredibly social companion who will bring laughter and warmth into your home, Royal is ready to steal your heart and become your family’s new best friend.

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Meet Tiger 🐾 Tiger is a confident and charismatic boy with a heart as big as his smile. This energetic bundle of joy is a true social butterfly who thrives on friendship—whether it’s with dogs big or small, Tiger’s easy-going nature and playful attitude make him a favourite in any multi-pet household. But don’t worry, he’s just as happy being the one and only furry family member, soaking up all the love and attention you can give. Tiger is the perfect blend of playful goofiness and calm confidence. He’s always ready to brighten your day with his silly antics, goofy grin, and endless tail wags. Despite his lively energy, he knows how to relax and enjoy quiet cuddle time, making him a well-rounded companion. What really sets Tiger apart is his gentle and loving spirit. He’s great with children, understanding and patient, making him an ideal family dog. Whether it’s playing games in the yard or snuggling up for story time, Tiger is sure to be a beloved member of your home. If you’re looking for a loyal, happy, and affectionate friend who will keep you smiling and fill your days with love, Tiger is the perfect match. He’s confident, outgoing, and ready to bring joy to a home that appreciates a lively, loving, and goofy boy with a heart full of love. Could Tiger be the one to steal your heart?

NAME: T Rex
TEXT: Meet T-Rex 🦕 Dog Friendly: Yes – best with medium to large dogs Child Friendly: Yes – best suited to a home with older children Ideal Home: A family with a secure backyard and an active lifestyle Don’t let the name fool you – T-Rex is all heart and happiness! This big, bouncy boy is bursting with personality and ready to find a family who’ll love his enthusiastic, affectionate nature. T-Rex is a social butterfly through and through. He’s currently living with other greyhounds and thrives in their company, especially those who can match his playful energy. He’s also friendly with medium and large dogs, and loves being part of a pack. This boy lives for his people – always close by, always ready to join in. Whether you're moving around the house or heading out for an adventure, expect T-Rex to be your loyal shadow. He’s interactive, affectionate, and happiest when included. T-Rex would do best in a home with older children who can enjoy his energy and help guide his big personality. A backyard is a must – he’s got some serious zoomie skills and needs space to stretch those long legs. While he’s eager to get out and explore, T-Rex can be strong on the lead, so he’ll need confident handlers who can continue his training and help him channel his excitement on walks. He will be your super social and loyal shadow and sidekick If you’re ready for a fun, affectionate, and outgoing greyhound who will bring non-stop joy and energy into your life, T-Rex is your guy.

NAME: Red
TEXT: Meet Red ❤️ Say hello to Red – a tender-hearted boy with a sweet soul and the most soulful eyes you’ve ever seen. Red may be a little reserved at first, but once he feels safe and settled, he shows his loving personality in the most heartwarming ways. Red is great with other greyhounds and enjoys their calm, familiar company. He’s also been around smaller dogs – he just may need a slower, thoughtful introduction to build his comfort and confidence. With the right introductions and guidance, he’s more than happy to share his space with gentle doggy friends. Red has been around children in a home environment and handles it well with his naturally gentle nature. However, due to his shy disposition, a quieter home – perhaps with older, dog-savvy kids – would be the best match for him. He thrives in calm, predictable spaces where he can truly feel at ease. Red can be a bit nervous when meeting new people or exploring new situations, but give him time and patience, and you’ll be rewarded with the trust and love of a truly special dog. He prefers to interact on his own terms – not pushy or demanding, just quietly curious and kind. Red enjoys his peaceful moments, lounging nearby, quietly observing, and choosing when to come over for a little affection or company. His independence, mixed with his loving nature, makes him a calm and comforting presence in the home. Red would thrive in a gentle, patient home where he can settle in at his own pace and build trust with his new family. He doesn’t ask for much – just kindness, understanding, and a safe space where he can be himself. In return, you’ll get a loyal, loving companion with the sweetest heart.

NAME: Finn
TEXT: Meet Finn 🌸 Introducing Finn – a quiet sweetheart with a gentle heart and a peaceful presence. This lovely girl may be a little shy when you first meet her, but once she feels safe, her soft personality begins to shine through 💕🐾 Finn is wonderfully social with other dogs – big or small. She’s respectful, calm, and happy to let others take the spotlight, making her an ideal companion for a household with other canine friends after a slow introduction. 🐕🐾 Finn has lived with children before and is gentle and patient with little ones. While she tends to keep to herself, she’s more than happy to be part of a loving family. She would do best in a home where kids understand that she might need a bit of time and space to settle in. Finn might take a little time to come out of her shell, but once she feels at ease, she’ll quietly sneak her way into your heart. She doesn’t demand attention but loves being near her people, soaking up the calm and comfort of a loving home. She’s the kind of dog who’s happy to do her own thing – whether it’s napping in a cozy spot or quietly observing from a distance. But don’t be surprised if she comes over for a gentle nuzzle or a loving glance – Finn gives affection in her own soft, sweet way. 🥰

NAME: Goose
TEXT: Meet Goose – the big-hearted goofball! 🐾 Goose is a gentle boy who loves being part of whatever you’re doing—whether it’s pottering in the garden, hanging out in the shed, or going for a drive (he’s a great traveller!). He’s recently discovered the joys of indoor life—lounging on the couch or his bed with legs in the air is a favourite pastime! Goose is house-trained, sun-bakes like a pro ☀️, and also enjoys a comfy spot on the verandah or patio. Friendly with everyone he meets, Goose loves toys (especially his beloved soccer ball!), swims, and easy, sniffy walks. He’s met kids 10+ and is calm around other dogs🐶. Goose is easy-going, friendly and happy who would love a home where someone is around more often than not, easily suited to retirees to travel with or someone wanting a companion dog He’s quiet, only giving the occasional bark for more pats or when dinner’s on the way. Apart from missing two toes from an old puppy injury he still likes a walk, preferably on grass, and is a healthy, affectionate boy ready to share his big heart with you. 💙

NAME: Selwin
