TEXT: Meet Selwin 🖤 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* Say hello to Selwin, a gorgeous boy with a soft heart, curious mind, and a lifetime of love to give. Selwin may take a little time to warm up, but once he trusts you, you’ll have a loyal and affectionate companion by your side. Selwin has grown up around children and knows how to be calm and gentle in their presence. He’s also well-socialised with other dogs, getting along beautifully with medium and large breeds—including other greyhounds and even a German Shepherd buddy! He’d love a home where he can share space with canine companions or be your one-and-only shadow. This sweet boy has a thoughtful, inquisitive nature. He enjoys taking in the world at his own pace and has proven to be unfazed by nearby farm animals like sheep and horses—nothing much rattles Selwin's cool composure. What would make Selwin happiest? A quiet home with a backyard or courtyard where he can potter around, stretch his legs, and soak up the sun between naps. While he doesn’t need a lot of exercise, he appreciates the freedom to explore a safe outdoor space. His independent and relaxed personality also makes him well-suited for full-time workers—he’s perfectly happy doing his own thing while you’re away, then greeting you with a wag and a nuzzle when you return. If you’re looking for a gentle, low-maintenance companion with a big heart and a quiet charm, Selwin might just be the boy for you. With a bit of patience and a lot of love, he’ll blossom into your most devoted friend. 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Mia
TEXT: Mia is a playful young girl who likes to play and stretch out before lounging around. She has lived around different sized dogs, domestic and native animals without issue. She is a beautiful affectionate girl who is also good on the lead. She is also comfortable on her own.

NAME: Cobber
TEXT: Cobber is a stunning lad, he is good with kids, social around different breeds of dogs and would be great company. He is easy on the lead and comfortable on his own.

NAME: Vaughn
TEXT: Vaughn has been described by his handlers as simply "amazing"! He is outgoing and affectionate with people & would suit a family home with a yard for him to relax in. He cannot wait to show you his Vaughn-derful personality! He is highly engaged with his training, best suited to house/townhouse living and settles alone well in a backyard setting. He’s already learned a bunch of tricks like 'down', shake, recall, his name, and on/off bed, and he’s currently working on sit. He’s quick to pick things up! He will need a home with a yard where he can run and play till his heart’s content. A family that will continue to help him on his training journey and a calm, loving environment where he can relax and feel secure. His best home is a family who want to do dog training, adventures and cool fun activities with him! Vaughn is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bub
TEXT: Meet Bub! Say hello to Bub, a sweet-natured older girl who’s ready to enjoy the simple pleasures of retirement. Bub is looking for a quiet, peaceful home where she can soak up the sun, enjoy some gentle pats, and claim a soft, cosy bed as her own. With her graceful charm and soft eyes, Bub has a spring in her step, but she’s very low-maintenance when it comes to exercise – a short burst of energy in the yard, a few short strolls and a bit of backyard sunbathing are all she needs to be content. She would thrive as an only dog, but she’s also happy to share her space with a male greyhound companion. Bub is a great match for full-time workers if there’s a secure backyard where she can relax during the day. She would also suit a calm household with older children who respect her quiet nature. If you're after a gentle soul who’s past the puppy chaos and just wants to be your loyal companion, Bub might just be the girl you’ve been waiting for. ☀️ Loves: Sunbaking, soft beds, peaceful vibes 🏡 Best home: Quiet environment, backyard, solo or with a male greyhound 💙 Personality: Calm, sweet, gentle, quietly affectionate 🦴 Exercise needs: Minimal – a yard for a quick zoom, a gentle stroll, she’s more nap than zoom Let Bub bring serenity, love, and a little sparkle into your life.

NAME: Zippa
TEXT: Meet Zippa!🐾 Zippa is a charming, affectionate boy who’s never met a dog he didn’t want to be friends with—especially if they’re fellow greyhounds! He thrives on canine company and is always the first to say hello with a happy wag and a gentle nuzzle. This social superstar settles quickly into new environments and brings calm confidence wherever he goes. Whether it’s a bustling park or a cozy home, Zippa makes himself right at home in no time. He absolutely adores human affection and will happily lean in for cuddles, neck scritches, and all the love you’re willing to give. With his friendly nature and easy-going personality, Zippa is a joy to have around and will make a wonderful companion for a home with other dogs—or just humans ready to shower him with love.

NAME: Jazz
TEXT: Meet Jazz! 🎷 Jazz is a laid-back, friendly girl with a lovely nature and a true love for canine company. She currently lives with other dogs and absolutely adores them—playtime with her four-legged friends is one of her favourite things in the world! While she’s polite and relaxed around new people, Jazz is definitely more of a “dogs before humans” kind of girl, always happiest when she’s part of a playful pack. This cool and easy-going girl travels like a pro and is perfectly at ease in the car, making her a great companion for road trips, day outings, or simply tagging along for the ride. Jazz takes everything in stride and brings a calm, contented energy wherever she goes. With her sweet, social nature and gentle personality, Jazz would thrive in a home with other dogs and a relaxed routine. If you're looking for a happy, well-adjusted boy who loves her canine companions and brings a quiet charm to every room, Jazz might just be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Rose
TEXT: Meet Rose!🌹 Rose is as lovely as her name suggests — a sweet, affectionate, and joyful greyhound who’s ready to fill her forever home with love, laughter, and plenty of cuddles. This social butterfly gets along beautifully with other dogs and is wonderful with children, making her a perfect match for a family home or anyone looking for a friendly companion to share life’s adventures. Rose loves her humans and thrives on affection — she’s happiest when she’s being cuddled, fussed over, or showered in kisses (which she’ll gladly return!). With her super affectionate nature and calm, gentle spirit, Rose has earned the title of “big cuddle monster” from everyone who’s met her. Whether she’s curled up next to you on the couch, leaning in for pats, or simply following you from room to room, she’ll always find a way to be close and connected. Rose is a confident, happy girl who’s ready to take on the world with her new family by her side. If you're looking for a loving, loyal, and snuggly companion who will be your shadow and your biggest fan, Rose is ready to blossom in her forever home.

NAME: Pebbles
TEXT: Meet Pebbles! 🐶 Pebbles is a bright, bubbly, and super social greyhound who’s ready to win hearts wherever she goes! This lovely lady has a big personality and an even bigger heart — she adores the company of other dogs and gets along with absolutely everyone she meets, both two-legged and four. Pebbles has been well-socialised in the community and is comfortable and confident in a variety of environments. She’s spent plenty of time indoors and knows how to settle into home life with ease. Whether she's out and about or relaxing at home, Pebbles is always engaged, curious, and tuned into her humans. She’s a huge fan of pats, cuddles, and—of course—treats! Show her a snack and she’ll be your best friend in an instant. Her friendly, affectionate nature makes her a joy to be around, and she’s always up for a chat (or at least a tail wag and a nuzzle). Pebbles would thrive in a home where she can continue being part of the action—whether it’s social outings, doggy playdates, or simply lounging at your feet after a day full of love and attention. If you're looking for a sweet, sociable girl who’s already got the hang of home life and is ready to be your loyal companion, Pebbles is your perfect match.

NAME: Laverne
TEXT: Meet Laverne! 🌸 Laverne is a sweet and sociable greyhound who’s ready to charm her way into your heart — and your home! This lovely girl gets along beautifully with other dogs, especially fellow greyhounds, and would make a wonderful addition to a home with canine companions. Laverne has been exposed to life both indoors and out, and she handles it all like a pro. She’s comfortable walking through busy streets and settles quickly once back inside, making her a great fit for suburban or city living. She's already shown she knows how to make herself at home — whether it’s lounging on a comfy bed or quietly hanging out with her humans. Always up for affection, Laverne will happily trot over for pats, cuddles, and a bit of love. Her gentle, friendly nature makes her easy to fall for, and she thrives on human connection without being overly demanding. With her easy-going temperament and affectionate heart, Laverne is ready to become a loyal and loving house pet. If you’re looking for a sweet companion who’s as calm as she is cuddly, Laverne could be your perfect match.

NAME: Rodney
TEXT: Meet Rodney! 🎾 Rodney is the kind of greyhound everyone dreams of — a friendly, easy-going, and happy soul who makes a perfect family pet. He’s fully house trained, so he knows how to settle into home life with ease and respect your space. Rodney truly loves children and has a gentle, patient nature that makes him wonderful with kids of all ages. Whether it’s playtime or quiet moments, he’s always ready to be a loyal and loving companion. His friendly and sociable personality means he gets on well with all dogs, big or small, and he enjoys meeting new furry friends wherever he goes. One of Rodney’s favourite pastimes is playing — especially chasing and retrieving balls! He’s got a playful spirit that can light up any backyard or park outing, but he’s just as happy curling up for a cozy rest when the fun winds down. His balanced energy makes him a great fit for families who want a dog that’s both lively and relaxed. Rodney’s easy-going nature and warm temperament make him a true social butterfly. He thrives on companionship and is happiest when he’s part of family activities, whether that’s going for walks, playing games, or simply hanging out together. If you’re searching for a loving, playful, and well-mannered greyhound who will bring joy and friendship to your home, Rodney is ready and waiting to become your new best friend!

NAME: Mitch
TEXT: Meet Mitch! 🐾 Mitch is a friendly and affectionate boy who has a special fondness for fellow medium to large dogs. He’s sociable and gets along well with his larger canine peers, making him a great addition to a home with other dogs. Mitch would be best suited to a family with older children who understand his gentle nature and can enjoy his calm companionship. He has excellent recall, so you can trust him to listen and respond during walks and outings. Affection is Mitch’s love language—he adores pats and treats and will happily soak up all the attention you’re willing to give. He settles quickly into new environments and adapts easily, making transitions smooth and stress-free. Whether at home or on the go, Mitch travels well and is perfectly happy to go in and out of his crate, seeing it as a cozy and safe space. If you’re looking for a loving, well-mannered greyhound who enjoys canine company, gentle affection, and life’s little adventures, Mitch is ready to bring joy to your home.

NAME: Magpie
TEXT: Magpie is a very charming and affectionate boy, he is great with other greyhounds and has lived around a Labrador in semi rural environment. Has been walked by kids regularly.

NAME: Ivy
TEXT: Ivy is a beautiful girl who loves to play, like most greyhounds she loves a morning zoomie and a bit of fun followed by some serious relaxing and lounging around. She is sweet social and confident girl.

NAME: Chester B
TEXT: Chester is a lovely boy who gets on with all size and shaped dogs and is great with kids. He is a social and confident boy.

NAME: Romeo
TEXT: *Romeo is in a foster care home in the Inner West* Foster Update: Romeo is super happy, affectionate and playful pup (no resource guarding or sleep startle observed). He is quite confident and outgoing at home. When he’s asleep he is angelic and when he is awake, he is effervescent. He has settled in quickly, he knows where his beds are and has a sleep bed and a play bed, he figured out very quickly where his toys live and how to dig the goat horn his favourite toy out of the basket. Romeo is a quick learner and has now mastered indoor and outdoor steps. He is responding to his name most of the time. His playful antics make us laugh to no end. He is happy to pass dogs on a footpath without much notice. Favourite things about him: His beautiful soulful eyes, his stunning looks, his mischievous personality, his independence and his affectionate behaviour. *Romeo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre via appointment with his foster carer*

NAME: Bert
TEXT: Bert is a shy boy who is growing more confidence every day. He is adorable, endearing, tiny in size, and has these bright brown eyes... He most importantly has a one of a kind, amazing personality which one lucky family will get to see! He has a wiggly goofy side and we all love him at the centre as we've seen him transform and grow in confidence. Once he knows you he is super affectionate and friendly & even has an excitable and playful side that is coming out more and more. What has helped him grow in confidence is his love of food and treats, and other dogs his size. He gets a lot of social support and confidence from other greyhounds. We think an experienced greyhound owner, a quiet nurturing home, and a backyard/townhouse will set Bert up for success. Teenage kids who have experience with shy dogs would be suitable. We are looking for a perfect fit for our Bert and we are hoping you love him too! This goofy, quirky, adorable little guy is available soon at Western Sydney. Chat with the team to arrange a meet and greet for when he becomes available!

NAME: Skye
TEXT: Skye has conquered foster care & is available to adopt. Here is a recent update from her foster parents! "She is a champion on the stairs, and also has mastered the elevators. She is smart girl and has pretty much memorised the walk down the corridor, into the elevator, through the carpark to the "doggie wee lawn outside our building. When leaving the elevator she knows which door in the corridor is ours! She is a dream on the lead. She is happy to walk at your pace. She is super clean, and that is good in an apartment. She has chewed/destroyed nothing, although loves bursts of playtime with her toys. absolute good girl. snuggle bunny, affectionate and so, so sweet." This super friendly and affectionate girl loves to sit in your lap, and loves everyone she meets! She would prefer to love all to herself in the home so a home without any existing pets is best. She would suit walkies or calm play dates with calm dogs big or small. This lovely lady is looking for somewhere to put her paws up, and she settles well indoors, and can even do stairs, making her apartment suited! She also has lovely leash manners and promises to walk nicely beside you for trips around the block. Skye is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bobby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Bobby is a lovely, quiet and friendly boy who has experience with kids 6-10 yrs old. He's been learning about the family household and has spent time mingling with other breeds including German Shepherds, and would suit a home with a Medium-Large dog friend. He likes playing with kids, fine meeting new people and strangers, and has a confident, adaptable nature about him. Did we mention he has adorable floppy ears, too? Meet Bobby at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Nacho
TEXT: Taco bout cute! We don't want to make it too cheesy, but in between napping and playtime, we think Nacho's got what it takes to salsa into your life like he's always been there. Nacho would be a great accompaniment to a home with another small, medium or large dog! He is affectionate, friendly and confident. Respectful with dog experience would be a great match. He’s looking for a family who can appreciate a dog with a zest for life (and cheesy puns...) Nacho is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. All you have to do is bring the love (and maybe some chips).

NAME: Yori
TEXT: Meet Yori 🐾💙 If you’re after a cheerful, people-loving, tail-wagging goofball of a greyhound... look no further than Yori! This happy boy is bursting with personality and charm – the kind of dog who lights up every room (and park, and café, and office!) he walks into. Yori is an all-around social butterfly. He absolutely loves people and wants to say hello to everyone he meets – humans, dogs, kids, you name it. He’ll trot over with his big happy grin, lean in for pats, and soak up every bit of love like the big softie he is. He’s also a classic Velcro hound – always ready to follow you from room to room like your biggest fan (which, let’s be honest, he is). Whether you're cooking dinner, working from home, or binge-watching your favourite show, Yori will be right there, just happy to be near you. ✅ Great with other dogs ✅ Wonderful with children ✅ Equally happy solo or with a greyhound friend ✅ Loves cuddles, pats, and being part of the action ✅ Would make the perfect office dog (he’d love to go to work with you!) Despite his goofy, happy-go-lucky nature, Yori is easy-going and well-mannered. He doesn’t ask for much – just your company, a few good belly rubs, and the chance to be your loyal sidekick. Yori is ready to be your best mate – at home, at work, and everywhere in between. He’s got love to give, a wag for everyone, and a heart as big as his smile.

NAME: Berry
TEXT: *Berry is in a foster care home in an apartment - reach out to the team to meet her!* Berry is a sweet girl ready to be picked! 🍓 Berry is a cute, friendly, gentle and fun girl who does well in apartment/indoor settings, and who would suit a home with respectful kids. Berry is jam-packed with an adorable personality and she can't wait to share it with you! She could build up to longer hours left alone in a quiet neighbourhood. Berry is looking to be a solo pet, so a home without other dogs would be berry nice. Despite her greying face and salt and pepper eyebrows, this girl is still young and looking for her perfect home. Contact Western Sydney to adopt her!

NAME: Queenie
TEXT: Meet Queenie 👑🐾 Say hello to Queenie, a gentle and affectionate Greyhound with a heart as regal as her name. This lovely lady has a calm, easy going nature and is looking for a forever home where she can truly shine. Queenie adores the company of other dogs – big or small – and would happily share her home with a canine companion. She's wonderfully social and enjoys doggy playtime, but she’s also content to curl up for a snooze after a bit of fun. She’d thrive in a home with someone who works part-time or works from home, as she loves being around her people but is also independent enough to enjoy her own space. Queenie walks beautifully on the lead – no pulling or zigzagging – making strolls an absolute joy. One of her favourite things is playing with toys, and she’s got a charming, playful streak that will melt your heart. If you're looking for a sweet, easy going companion who’s great with other dogs and makes every day a little brighter, Queenie could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Meet Cindy! 🐾 Say hello to Cindy, a beautifully relaxed and loving girl who's ready to bring warmth and joy into a forever home. With her gentle soul and easy-going nature, Cindy is one of those special dogs who fits in just about anywhere. She’s brilliantly behaved, loves the company of other dogs, and is wonderfully gentle with children – making her a perfect addition to families, couples, or anyone simply looking for a calm and affectionate companion. Cindy’s biggest joy in life is being with her people. Whether she’s nuzzling in for kisses, leaning in for cuddles, or gently pawing for another pat, she’ll melt your heart in an instant. She’s also playful in the most delightful way – happy to toss around a toy in the backyard before stretching out in the sun for a lazy afternoon snooze. Cindy doesn’t ask for much – just love, comfort, and a family to share her sweetheart with. If you're looking for a calm, cuddly, sunshine-loving greyhound who will adore you endlessly, Cindy is waiting to meet you.

NAME: Double
TEXT: Meet Double! 🐾 Looking for a fun, friendly, go-anywhere kind of dog? Double might just be your perfect match! This gorgeous boy is as adaptable as they come – he’d thrive in just about any environment, whether it’s a busy family home or a quieter setting with active humans. Double walks beautifully on the lead, gets along wonderfully with all dogs, and adores children of all ages. He loves his people and to be involved with everything going on inside your household. With his playful, engaging personality, Double is always up for some fun – especially if it involves toys or exploring new places. He’d love a family that enjoys adventures and will include him in their day-to-day life, from park strolls to weekend outings. Double is more than ready to bring joy, fun, and a whole lot of love into his forever home!

NAME: Minnie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Little miss Minnie is a gentle, loving girl here at the adoption centre. Minnie can be cautious and curious around new dogs and people but we know she will become an amazing pet. Minnie is very comfortable around other greyhounds and we think a home with another greyhound would support her confidence and social learning! Minnie has a high food drive and is very switched on, showing you can teach an old pup new tricks. This little lady will thrive in a calm, supportive home. Minnie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cashew
TEXT: Cashew is a small, smart, vibrant and cheerful girl. She has an energetic side and would do best with an active and stimulating life, with a backyard to call her own. A structured routine and someone who enjoys the company of a confident, engaged dog, would be the best fit. Someone who enjoys dog training and living a fun, full life, would love having Cashew by their side. Cashew has some experience around older children and would suit living in a family with kids as she would keep the kids entertained and would love to be part of your daily activites. This gorgeous girl is super friendly, active, curious, loves to run and play, chase balls and live a fun life! This adorable little girl can be adopted at Western Sydney.

NAME: Stripes
TEXT: Meet Stripes! 🐾 Say hello to Stripes, a handsome boy with a heart as big as his personality! This sweet-natured greyhound is an all-around superstar – he absolutely adores other dogs and is wonderfully gentle with children, making him the perfect companion for families of all kinds. Stripes is a model kennel dog – clean, calm, and relaxed in his space. Out and about, he walks beautifully on the lead, enjoying every stroll with curiosity and grace. With his outgoing and affectionate personality, Stripes loves meeting new people and making friends wherever he goes. If you’re looking for a friendly, sociable, and easy-going greyhound who fits in just about anywhere, Stripes is your guy!

NAME: Buttercup
TEXT: Buttercup is a gentle older girl, looking for a calm and peaceful life. She would suit a home with or without a dog friend. She is friendly with the small dogs here, showing off her laid back nature. She also enjoys spending time with another senior female greyhound, Wanda, in our office. Full time hours/working families are suitable for Buttercup as she does not fret when left alone in our office setting. This older gal would suit older/quiet children who will let her have her peace and quiet that she deserves. She could also spend her days relaxing in an apartment (with lift access). Buttercup is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lyla
TEXT: Lyla is a delightful girl with a fun personality that is perfectly balanced by her sweet and gentle nature. Lyla's charm and warmth are sure to bring joy to any household. She is super affectionate, confident, loves people and loves to do a zoomie! Older children would enjoy her fun side, and laid back couples/families would enjoy her adaptable nature if living in a unit/apartment with an active lifestyle. This gorgeous girl would suit some hours alone as a solo dog. She requires a home without any other doggie pals. She can also do stairs! She makes her a wonderful companion for families or individuals looking for an active yet loving friend. A family that enjoys playtime and outdoor activities would be perfect for her. At the same time, she appreciates quiet moments of affection and will happily snuggle up for some downtime. Lyla is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: *Lulu is in a foster care home in an apartment - reach out to the team to meet her!* Lulu has great leash manners, enjoys spending time indoors, happy for some hours alone (even likes a crate!), and did we mention she can "sit"? Lulu shows lots of training potential as a few treats are the way to this girls heart. Lulu loves to give affection just as much as she loves to give it and cant wait to find her new family. Her new family might even already have a another dog, which Lulu wouldn't mind! She is apartment suitable, suitable for children and is very affectionate and trainable. Are you ready for lovely Lulu to become apart of your family? Meet her at Western Sydney 😄

NAME: Buddy
TEXT: Meet Buddy! A happy, friendly dog who loves meeting people, is easy going and loves life. Basking in the sun is one of his favourites past-times, as is playing in the yard with his greymates and attention from his humans. He loves it when he comes inside and lies on the rug but would love a couch all to himself (currently occupied by the 'boss' girls). He's also happy spending time on his own during the day, hanging out in the garden, sun-snoozing on the grass or in a sheltered spot in cooler times (veranda, gazebo). Buddy has also met a Maremma and a Great Dane x, and is an easy maintenance lad who just wants some love and attention and a cruisy, simple life. He will making a loving companion for anyone wanting an affectionate friend to hang out with. 💙

NAME: Veruca
TEXT: Hi, I'm Veruca! I'm a sweet, gentle girl looking for a place to call home! I love my walks and have shown to be quite well mannered whilst I'm out and about. I may be a little shy at first but once I warm up to you, I love lots of pats and ear scratches. I love my greyhound buddies, and pending a meet and greet, I wouldn't mind going home with canine companion! I cant wait to meet my new family 🏠 If you think I might be the girl for you, come meet me at Western Sydney 🐾

NAME: Lily
TEXT: Lily is a confident, friendly, and playful girl with a heart full of love! Affectionate and cuddly, she adores being around people and is great with kids aged 5 and up. Lily gets along well with both small (mini groodle) and large dogs (other greys, kelpie cross, Rottweiler), is respectful of the indoor cat, has ignored birds flying around her and she sits on cue (food motivated)- she’s a true all-rounder! She enjoys her daily walk and a good game of chase, but her bursts of energy are short-lived—after that, she’s ready to relax and soak up cuddles, preferably on the couch! Lily has spent time living inside and definitely knows her name and how to make herself at home. Lily is a beautiful little girl who would thrive in a loving home with a someone who can enjoy watching her zoomies in the morning, go for nice walks, and lots of snuggles with her. She’d prefer to be with another grey or a medium-small dog for workers. 💗

NAME: Roman
TEXT: Roman is a stunning calm boy with a loving nature. He is great company, easy to be around and is already living in suburban household like a valued family member. He is a confident boy who has no issues being on his own while your at work.

NAME: Barney
TEXT: Barney is a charming boy, he may use some caution when meeting someone new however he will open up quite quickly and show his beautiful personality. He is very friendly, great to walk on the lead and is relaxed when left alone. He is gentle and great with kids.

NAME: Wren
TEXT: Wren is a gentle, sweet-natured girl who can be a bit shy at first, but once you sit quietly and let her come to you, her affectionate personality shines through. A few treats and a little chat go a long way with this lovely lady! She loves her morning zoomies and playtime with her retired greyhound friends, then settles in for some chill time with the family – including a whippet, a Jack Russell, and three older greyhounds. She's well-behaved indoors and enjoys being part of the daily routine. Wren walks beautifully on the lead and is calm and confident around town – not fazed by traffic, past school playgrounds, other dogs, or people. She’s a happy, social girl who loves a gentle pat and attention. Wren would make a wonderful companion in a variety of homes. She’d be happy as an only dog with someone who’s home often or works part-time from home. She’d also be delighted to share her home with a small, friendly dog, especially a whippet. If you're looking for a loyal, gentle, and loving new friend, Wren could be the perfect match for you! 💝

NAME: Son
TEXT: Hi, I'm Son! I've been described as calm, loving, sociable, and easy going! I'm happy travelling, snoozing in crates, snuggling into new people for a bit of attention and pats. I've got a charming nature and I think I'm pretty adaptable in new situations! I would suit respectful kids and a backyard to search for my toys in! I'm a confident fella who can't wait to meet you. You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Jay
TEXT: Hello, aren't I handsome? My name is Jay and I can't wait to meet you... A little bit about me. I've been around kids 3 and up, and even spent some time hanging out with a sausage dog which I thought was pretty fun! My ideal home? Well I'd like a townhouse or backyard, gotta show off my zoomies and snooze in the sun of course. I can be a bit shy so I hope you have the patience to see me grow into a confident boy along side you. I really like a gentle touch and an understanding person to make me feel comfortable. Please come and see me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sparrow
TEXT: Tweet tweet....a little birdie tells me you may have just found your perfect match! Did you know I was born on February 29th? Yep, I'm a "Leapling"! This little cutie is a shy girl, looking for a nurturing home to call her own. She has had some experience around dogs including her fellow greyhounds and would enjoy a calm, peaceful life to support her to thrive into the brave girl we know she can be. She prefers cuddling and relaxing over play time and adventures, and would ideally suit a homebody in a quiet neighbourhood. Respectful teens/tweens would be best suited, as Sparrow has some experience around older kids. Come meet this sweet girl at Western Sydney!

NAME: Edi
TEXT: Hi, I'm Edi! I was born on Christmas Day! I can be shy around new people but I promise to be a total love bug once I know you! I'm learning about all things "pet" right now including being indoors, things like couches and TV's are pretty cool! I also like the crate, and the splashy pool in summer! I'm learning about busy streets and have mingled with kids, too. I am quiet, affectionate, calm and friendly and hope you would like to come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Scoot
TEXT: Small in size but BIG on love, personality, energy and good vibes, Scoot has shown us her amazing personality while at the adoption centre. Scoot truly conquers the world with confidence - and is NOT your typical greyhound! Scoot requires an experienced owner with experience working with highly aroused dogs (think working dogs, kelpies, etc) to see their full potential through structure and a routine, who understands her needs and someone who loves Scoot for all her quirks. Her perfect owner would be someone who can commit to, and wants to, take her for lots of walks, engage in play, enrichment and a constant outlet for her energy. In saying that, she settles well for full time hours if she'd had a long walk (1 hour) and then can be left during the day. Scoot would love a home with another goofy dog friend however often she often lacks proper social skills - so a tolerant dog friend who doesn't mind her shenanigans is best. As for her perfect home, she would be happy chilling in an apartment if her needs above are met (she also likes a crate). Stairs are fine by her too! She has a high energy and bouncy nature so if you have a backyard she'd love that, too. Teenage kids with big dog experience would be best suited, as to avoid overstimulation. Scoot is incredibly social, she LOVES people and cuddles. If you can commit to training, and want to see Scoot thrive, come and meet her at the Western Sydney adoption centre. Once she gets to know you we promise she will roll into your lap (see photos!)

NAME: China
TEXT: Watch out for those big puppy dog eyes! Sweet little China is as precious as his porcelain name! China is a fun, sometimes shy, sometimes playful, sweet boy looking for a home! China is polite with big and small dogs on walkies and would be happy to share his new world with a dog by his side. He walks nicely on lead and has your quintessential greyhound personality of zoomies, naps and will always greet you with a little wagging tail. Respectful children are welcome, too. We can't wait to see who loves China as much as we do! China can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billy Bob
TEXT: Hi, I'm Billy-Bob, I'm a gentle boy who is waiting someone just like you! I am polite, great with new people and have shown that I will do anything for a little treat! I haven't yet spent time in a home or around those little people called children, but due to my sweet nature I think I'll do well where ever I step paws. I'm a really nice guy who promises to be your new best friend and someone who will accompany you on all your adventures to come. You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dennis
TEXT: Dennis is a polite and confident middle aged gentleman who is happy to receive pats and attention from any of his admirers! Dennis would suit a home with respectful children who are looking for an affectionate play mate. Dennis walks nicely on the lead and loves to catch up on all the sniffs around town while showing off his good looks. Dennis is a lovely gentleman who will thrive with a townhouse/backyard and or doggie friends to keep him company! Dennis can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre

NAME: Diesel
TEXT: With his sweet little undershot jaw, Diesel oozes character both on the outside and on the inside! This sweet dog is good with children and other dogs, he is ready to slot right into family life and find a sofa to call his own. Whist he loves to play ball and goof around, Diesel is also happy to curl up next to his person for a cuddle and a snooze!

NAME: Yukey
TEXT: Meet Yuckey! 🐶💖 Yuckey is a sweet and playful girl with a heart full of love and a special bond with her best friend, Rufus. These two are inseparable and are looking for a forever home together where they can keep each other company and bring double the love. Yuckey walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys playtime with her toys and doggy friends. She’s equally happy to chill out and watch the world go by, making her a wonderful balance of fun and calm. If you're ready to open your home to a bonded pair full of love, personality, and charm, Yuckey and Rufus are ready to meet you! See Rufus' profile - https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/rufus-1

NAME: Rufus
TEXT: Introducing Rufus! 🐾❤️ Rufus is a gentle, social boy who absolutely adores his canine companions — especially his best mate, Yukey! These two are a bonded pair and are looking for a loving home together where they can continue their journey side by side. Rufus is calm, affectionate, and walks beautifully on the lead, making him a joy to take on daily strolls. He could also live with a cat, given a slow introduction. If you're looking to welcome not just one, but two sweet, well-mannered greyhounds into your heart and home, Rufus and Yukey might be the perfect duo for you! See Yuckey's profile here - https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/yukey

NAME: Sahsa
TEXT: Meet Sasha! 🐶 Sasha is a sweet and social greyhound who absolutely loves the company of other dogs! She currently lives happily with another canine companion and would thrive in a home with a doggy friend. Sasha is also a great traveller — she settles beautifully in the car, making her a perfect road trip buddy. Treats and toys are two of Sasha's favourite things, and her playful personality shines when she's having fun. While she adores other dogs, she’ll need a slow and thoughtful introduction to smaller pups to help her feel settled. If you’re looking for a loving, playful girl who’s ready to be part of the pack, Sasha could be your perfect match!

NAME: Longy
TEXT: Meet Longy! 🐶🌟 Longy is a bright, bubbly boy bursting with personality and charm! He’s a true social butterfly who adores both human and canine company, making friends wherever he goes. Longy is especially good with children and dogs of all sizes, though he’ll need a slow and gentle introduction to the littlest ones. This zoomie king loves to stretch his legs and would really thrive in a home with a backyard where he can let loose and have some fun. Whether he's playing, cuddling, or just soaking up the love, Longy brings joy to every moment. If you're after a fun, friendly, and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to be part of an active and loving home, Longy could be the perfect addition to your family!

NAME: Mow
TEXT: Meet Mow! 💖 Mow is a joyful, playful greyhound with a zest for life and a heart full of happiness! She’s a social girl who gets along wonderfully with medium to large dogs and would be more than happy to have a canine companion to share her days with. This toy-loving sweetheart is always up for a game or a bit of fun, and her cheerful personality is sure to brighten any home. Mow would be a perfect fit for an active household where she can join in on adventures, enjoy regular playtime, and be part of the family action. If you're looking for a fun, loving, and outgoing greyhound to be your next best friend, Mow is ready to meet you!

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris! 🐕 Boris is a high-energy, fun-loving boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. With his confident nature and bouncy enthusiasm, he’s always ready to play, explore, and soak up all the affection he can get. Boris gets along great with medium to large dogs and would thrive in an active home where he can be part of the action. Whether it’s going on adventures, playing in the yard, or just enjoying time with his people, Boris is all in. He would also love a friend at home to keep him company and is happy to play with him. If you’re an energetic family looking for a lively, loving companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Boris is your guy!

NAME: Jimothy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Jimothy. I'm a quiet and gentle boy who is nice on the lead. I can be a bit nervous around new people and new places but I am so eager to please. I can do a cute "sit" which took everyone by surprise! I love a gentle touch and reassurance, and would enjoy a home with another dog to build my confidence. Overall I can be summed up as gentle and charming and I hope you want to meet me, too! I can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jimmy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: If you love a quirky cute roman nose as much as us, you'll love Jimmy here at the Western Sydney centre. With an unforgettable face, Jimmy is sure to charm you not only with his good looks but with his polite and lovable personality. Jimmy has an easy going nature around people and dogs big and small. Older kids and a backyard/townhouse yard would be perfect for Jimmy who loves a quick zoomie and play. Jimmy can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Milo (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Milo. I love to get pats and will contort myself into weird positions to get all those good scratches! The team effortlessly fell in love with me when I first arrived here. I am an engaging, charismatic boy who still knows how to have a good time. I love to play bow and have my silly moments, but I am overall relaxed and can't wait to snooze in a sunny spot at your place. I'm a polite boy with other greyhounds and would happily join a family with another dog at home. I hope you're interested in meeting me! I'm available to adopt via the team at Western Sydney.

NAME: Puds
TEXT: Meet Puds! 🐾 Puds is a handsome greyhound with a heart as big as his zoomies! This laid-back boy loves nothing more than chilling out with other greyhounds and medium-to-large canine companions. He’s happy to kick back and relax but also has a playful side – especially when toys are involved! Puds is food-motivated and eager to please, making training a breeze. He’d thrive in an active home where he can join in on daily walks or adventures, then unwind with his humans. A backyard would be a bonus for this boy, giving him space to stretch his legs and let loose when the zoomie urge strikes. If you're looking for a loving, social, and fun companion with just the right mix of chill and energy, Puds could be your perfect match!

NAME: Gazza
TEXT: Gazza is a sweet boy who travels well in vans, cars and trailer, also walks well on lead on adventures out and about. Gazza has shown polite manners with children ranging from 20 months to 9 years old, showing a gentle & polite indifference. Gazza has spent time mingling with big and small dogs and would suit a home looking for a laid back boy happy to go with the flow. Gazza dreams of a little backyard to spend his days in and kids to keep him entertained during the day. He can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Malley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Malley! I've been learning lots of things about the world while I wait to be adopted. I know what a lounge is, how to navigate those weird things called "stairs", and have enjoyed spending time in an open crate, and spending time indoors, too! I'm a good traveller and would enjoy a life of adventures, sniffari's and pastries at cafe's! I also love toys and treats and my handlers call me a big softie! If you thought you might like a big affectionate softie like me simply reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre :)

NAME: Ocean
TEXT: Don't let my greying face fool you, I'm a friendly bubbly guy ready to join your family. Ocean is a curious and confident boy who loves his toys, has learnt his name and will even come when called. This serene boy walks nicely on the lead, too, making him a lovely walking companion. Ocean is a wonderful boy who is ready to bring balance and peace to his new home! Ocean can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption facility.

NAME: Soy
TEXT: Meet Soy, the joyful boy who is friendly, easy going and great with kids and dogs of all sizes. Soy's happy-go-lucky personality is perfect for anyone looking to bring energy and fun into their home. He would be happy to share his new life with other dogs big or small. Whether he's catching a ball or simply lounging by your side, Soy revels in the company of his human friends, showcasing his loyalty and affection in delightful ways. Soy can be adopted at Western Sydney!

NAME: Kenneth
TEXT: Kenneth loves playing with other dogs and would do well with a family who enjoy big playful dogs. Being middle aged, he's ready to take it easy and enjoy the retirement life but does have that fun streak! Kenneth is super food focused, learning all sorts of tricks while he waits for his forever home here at the centre. This includes the 'focus' cue, recall/come, touch and more. He's a friendly and affectionate boy who is suitable to live with respectful children or another M-L doggie pal providing they're a match for his bouncy play style with other dogs. He has the sweetest little face with an adorable personality to match. Come meet Kenneth at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Toby
TEXT: Toby is a confident and cheerful boy who is happy wherever he goes! If you're looking for a charming, affectionate and happy go lucky boy, Toby could be perfect for you. Toby would love a townhouse or backyard to practise his zoomies. We can see Toby fitting well into a household with polite children due to his lovable ways! Meet Toby at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack 🐾🌿 Jack is a confident, relaxed boy who takes everything in his stride. Whether it’s a new place, a new walk, or a new friend, Jack approaches life with a calm curiosity and a steady tail wag. He settles quickly into new environments, walks beautifully on the lead, and is a total pro when it comes to travelling. Whether you're heading out for a stroll or a weekend getaway, Jack is more than happy to come along for the ride. Jack’s gentle confidence and easy going nature make him a dream companion for anyone looking for a loyal friend who’s as chill as he is curious. If you're after a greyhound who’s ready to explore the world—but just as happy to lounge by your side—Jack’s your guy.

NAME: Albert
TEXT: Meet Albert 🐾 Albert is a quiet, clean, and gentle soul who’s ready to find his forever home. He’s the kind of greyhound who takes life in his stride—literally! He walks beautifully on the lead, travels like a pro, and is an all-around easy companion. While he can be a little shy at first, Albert warms up quickly and really comes into his own once he’s settled. He absolutely loves a good run with his canine pals and gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes. Albert would thrive in a calm, loving home where he can enjoy his daily walks, zoomies with friends, and a comfy spot to relax. If you're looking for a sweet, well-mannered boy with a playful side, Albert might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Chunk
TEXT: Meet Chunk – The Quiche-Connoisseur 🐶 Chunk is a friendly, easy-going boy with a heart of gold and a nose for snacks! He’s a social boy who loves the company of other dogs and would be more than happy to share his space (and his toys) with a furry friend. Don’t let his name fool you – Chunk is all charm and cheer. He may take a little time to say hello properly, but once he’s settled, he’s all smiles and tail wags. His gentle nature makes him a lovely companion, and he’s always up for a cuddle or a game. Be warned: Chunk is a bit of a food enthusiast. He may sneak a bite of your quiche if you’re not looking – but he promises to do it with love. 😄 If you’re after a laid-back, affectionate pup with a bit of a cheeky side, Chunk might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Baz
TEXT: Meet Baz 🐾 Baz is a cool and collected boy looking for a quiet, loving home where he can truly relax and be himself. With his soft eyes and calm nature, Baz is the perfect companion for someone who enjoys a peaceful lifestyle. He’s a little shy at first, but once he feels settled, Baz adores gentle cuddles and will happily lean in for a pat. He’s a quiet boy who enjoys his own space but loves nothing more than being near his people. Baz is great with dogs of all sizes and would do well with a calm canine friend, though he’d also be happy as a solo dog in the right home. Because of his gentle and sometimes shy nature, Baz would thrive in a low-traffic home without too much hustle and bustle. If you're looking for a soft-hearted, low-maintenance companion with a heart full of love, Baz might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Thor
TEXT: Thor – Mighty God of thunder and lightning and protector of mankind...this friendly boy from the moment he meets you, he’ll be buttering you up with his big puppy dog eyes asking for a treat. If you have an Avengers team of other hounds at home, we think that Thor wouldn’t mind some crime-fighting canine company, but he’s happy on his own as well for shorter stints of time alone to begin with. He would do best with a small grassed yard with opaque/colour bond fencing in a quiet neighbourhood as he can become overwhelmed with too much going on in the neighbourhood. His gentle and friendly nature would see him fit perfectly into a home with older kids or teens! If Thor (minus the hammer) sounds like the perfect fit for your Asgard, assemble your family, and together you can embark on a heroic journey to meet him at our Western Sydney adoption facility.

NAME: Snippy
TEXT: Snippy is a relaxed, friendly, easy-going boy who’s not jumpy and a dream on the lead. He’s super social, affectionate, and loves spending time with people - he just adores the grandkids aged 6 and up! Snippy’s happy nature makes him an excellent pet, he loves to lean on you and get cuddles which we just love! He’s great with other calm natured greys, and would prefer shorter hours alone as a solo pet. He loves his daily walks, swimming adventures, and is very food-motivated making him a breeze to train. He’d thrive in a home with someone who has time to hang out with him, who has a nice quiet backyard for him to chill out in. Snippy has mastered stairs so a home with some steps is A-O-K! This friendly fella is at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Meet Grace ☀️ Grace is a calm, friendly girl with a beautifully chilled personality and a love for the simple things in life — like a sunny spot to nap in and the company of other dogs. She’s previously lived happily with other canine companions and would love a home where she can continue to enjoy that friendship. She would be equally as happy being an only dog with her human friends. Grace has lived inside a home before; she walks nicely on the lead and travels well — making outings easy and enjoyable. Whether she's strolling beside you or stretching out in the sunshine, Grace brings a gentle, contented energy wherever she goes. She’s the perfect mix of affectionate and independent and would thrive in a home that appreciates her relaxed nature and loving heart. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who’s happy to share her space, her sunshine, and her heart — Grace is ready to meet you.

NAME: Edna
TEXT: Meet Edna 🌸 Edna is a lovely, soft-natured girl with a quiet charm and a heart full of potential. She enjoys the company of other dogs and her human friends. Edna walks beautifully on the lead and travels calmly, making her a joy to take out and about. While she may be a little shy at first, given time and gentle encouragement, she begins to show her sweet, affectionate personality. She would thrive in a quieter home where she can take things slowly and build confidence with patient people by her side, especially as she navigates new environments at her own pace. Once she feels settled, Edna blossoms — and her gentle companionship is truly special. If you're looking for a loyal friend to love and nurture, Edna might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Indi
TEXT: Meet Indi! 🐾 Indi is a sweet-natured girl with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging! She adores the company of other dogs and is always excited to make new canine (and human!) friends. With her calm and gentle nature, Indi is the kind of dog who turns heads and wins hearts wherever she goes. She's a fantastic traveller — relaxed and content whether it's a short trip to the park or a longer adventure. Patience is one of her superpowers, and she takes everything in stride with a happy grin and waggy tail. If you're looking for a friendly, sociable companion who's always happy to say hello, Indi is your girl. 💕🐶

NAME: Lewis
TEXT: Meet Lewis 🐶 Lewis is a bright, bouncy bundle of joy with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging! This friendly greyhound is fantastic with other dogs and has previously lived happily with other grey’s. He's a true social butterfly who fits right in with canine company. Great with children and always gentle, Lewis has that perfect mix of playful energy and relaxed charm. His happy-go-lucky nature makes him a joy to have around – whether you’re heading out for a walk or just relaxing at home, he’s always up for whatever’s going on. And yes, treats? Don’t even say the word unless you’re ready to hand one over – Lewis is a treat-loving legend! If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable, all-round good boy, Lewis could be your perfect match.

NAME: Horse
TEXT: Meet Horse 🐾 Horse might have a big name, but he’s a total softie at heart. This gorgeous boy is the definition of laid-back – calm, collected, and always up for a cuddle or a tasty treat (he’s a bit of a snack connoisseur!). Horse gets along brilliantly with other dogs, making him the perfect companion whether you're out on a group walk or welcoming visitors at home. He travels like a pro, whether it's a quick ride or a longer trip, and he's even happy to wait patiently in the car while you pop into the shops – no fuss, no bother. Friendly with everyone he meets and just the right amount of nosey (we call it “curious charm”), Horse has a gentle soul and a curious streak that keeps life interesting. If you’re after a relaxed, loving dog who’s as easy-going as they come, Horse is your guy. Treat in hand? You’ve got a friend for life, the Gentle Giant with a heart of gold!

NAME: Tracker
TEXT: He is a very strong dog has a beautiful nature. Loves attention. Would really suit someone that was into physical activities as he enjoys running around. adventure by day and relaxing by night

NAME: Baby Wow
TEXT: walks well on lead Confident and social. very chilled out dog jumps up and down playful and jumps up to give cuddles likes to go off and explore would love a big backyard good for fulltime working hours enjoys a zoomie

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: this beautiful boy is very easy going and suits the quieter life. he’s very easy to walk on lead very clean and healthy boy has socialised with French bulldogs through the fence regularly this boy would be great to chill out during the day and experience cuddles at night has a smile that would make you melt

NAME: Max
TEXT: Max is a beautiful active boy who loves to go on adventures max is suited to full time workers max loves older kids as he loves to play with toys and can sometimes forget his size with younger children. despite his energy max walks very well on lead max requires a larger fenced area to ensure he stays in the backyard all day as he can sometimes want to go and hang out around the neighbourhood. max is a clean and healthy boy and would suit your more active lifestyle

NAME: Chase
TEXT: Meet Chase 🛋️ Chase is a relaxed, confident greyhound who’s happiest when he’s chilling out in a comfy spot – true couch potato style! With his calm nature and chilled out personality, he’s a breeze to have around and would suit a home with full-time workers, especially if there’s a backyard for him to enjoy some sunshine and fresh air. He gets along well with medium to large dogs and absolutely adores children. While he hasn’t been around small dogs or cats just yet, he’s proven to be gentle and well-mannered in his interactions. If you’re after a low-maintenance companion who’s happy to nap the day away and greet you with love when you get home, Chase is your guy!

NAME: Franky
TEXT: Meet Franky 🐾 Franky is a sweet boy who adores the company of other dogs and would do well living with a feline friend, provided they have a very slow and gentle introduction. With his engaging personality, Franky loves to sniff and explore his surroundings, always curious about the world around him. He would thrive in a home with another pet to keep him company, especially where someone works from home or part-time, so he can enjoy plenty of companionship throughout the day. Franky’s playful spirit and affectionate nature make him a wonderful addition to a loving family ready to share adventures and quiet moments alike.

NAME: Tara
TEXT: Meet Tara 💖 Tara is a sweetheart with a lovely, gentle nature that makes her a joy to be around. She’s great with all dogs and adores children, making her a wonderful addition to any family. She would fit right into any household. Tara is the perfect mix of happy-go-lucky and couch potato. Once she is rid of her zoomies, she will snuggle up with you for the rest of the day. Tara absolutely loves pats, cuddles, and all the affection you can give. She’s a true cuddle bug who will happily soak up your love. She also travels well, making her a perfect companion for adventures near or far. She will happily cruise with you on your next adventure. If you’re looking for a friendly, affectionate greyhound who’s easy going and loving, Tara is ready to steal your heart!

NAME: Sam
TEXT: Say Hello to Sam – A Gentle Soul Ready to Bloom 🌱 Sam is a sweet boy who’s looking for a quiet home where he can truly come into his own. A little timid at first, Sam takes his time to get to know you– but once he feels settled, his playful and affectionate side begins to shine. He enjoys the simple joys in life: a gentle game in the yard with his canine friends, a few soft toys to toss around, and, of course, a tasty treat or two! Sam gets along well with other dogs and would love a calm canine companion to help boost his confidence. With a bit of patience and a lot of love, Sam will reward you with loyalty, quiet companionship, and those special moments that come from watching him blossom.

NAME: Davie
TEXT: Introducing Davie 🐾 Davie is a gentle, affectionate boy with a heart of gold and a tail that never stops wagging! This easy going boy is the perfect fit for just about any household – whether you have children, other dogs, or just need a calm companion by your side. He walks beautifully on a loose lead and has wonderfully relaxed body language, making strolls together an absolute pleasure. Davie is a social butterfly who gets along with dogs of all shapes and sizes, and his sweet, patient nature makes him a hit with kids too. Whether it’s lounging at home, greeting new friends, or enjoying a quiet walk, Davie’s laid-back personality and loving nature shine through in everything he does. If you're looking for a loyal, low-maintenance friend with lots of love to give, Davie might just be your perfect match!

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: Poppy is a gentle, goofy girl who’s stealing hearts while living her best foster life with a golden retriever buddy. She’s incredibly well-mannered, toilet trained, and even knows her basic commands – she’ll sit, lay down, and patiently wait for the go-ahead before eating. What a superstar! This gorgeous girl loves snuggles, going for walks, and being around her people. She’s got a curious nature and thrives on companionship, both human and canine. Poppy would do best in a home with another friendly dog to keep her company and help her continue building confidence. She has no problems with resource guarding and doesn't mind sharing her food and toys. While she’s mostly chill, Poppy does get a little sooky when you leave the house – but she settles down pretty quickly. Ideal Home: A secure backyard with fencing (a must for this curious girl!) Another friendly dog would be a bonus No cats or staffys, please An active lifestyle – she loves walks and adventures A home where someone is around a bit more often than not

NAME: Mojo
TEXT: Mojo is a gentle soul with a calming presence. He is a lovely gentleman who is a super sweet and affectionate fella. He settles well when left alone and would suit a full time worker family with a courtyard/backyard. He enjoys spending time with other greyhounds and due to his mature nature, could suit a home with another dog. Mojo has a low exercise budget being double digits now, he would be perfect for a low maintenance lifestyle, and someone who just wants to walk around the block for 10 minutes. He walks gently on the lead and is polite with dogs on walks. This lovely gentle boy will be a perfect addition to so many family styles. Mojo is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Abbey
TEXT: Meet Abbey 🐾 Say hello to Abbey, a playful and affectionate greyhound with a heart full of love and legs built for zoomies! This lovely girl is always up for a good run around the yard, followed by a snuggle session and some well-earned treats (her favourite currency!). Abbey is friendly with people and gets along wonderfully with medium to large dogs, and she'd be happy sharing her space with a calm, smaller canine companion too. She walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls with her a breeze, and she’s a seasoned car traveller. Whether she’s stretching her legs in a quick burst of zoomie joy or relaxing by your side, Abbey brings a perfect mix of energy and calm. If you're looking for a sweet, loyal, and fun-loving friend to brighten your days, Abbey could be your perfect match. ❤️

NAME: Macca
TEXT: This is Macca! What a sweetheart; a friendly energetic girl with beautiful brown eyes and a pretty face that will steal your heart. Macca is full of fun and playfulness—she loves toys, playtime, and pats, and just wants to get your attention, really. She would do well with some quiet downtime with her humans and best as an only dog or with another grey. She would thrive in a home with someone with the time to give her some calming guidance, lead practice, and the love she deserves to show her true potential. Macca would be a loyal companion who will return your love tenfold. If you're looking for a devoted best friend with a wagging tail, a soft heart and a skip in her step, Macca's your girl!

NAME: Sherman
TEXT: Meet Sherman. Mr. Personality Plus Pup! What a beautiful friendly young lad, still a goofy puppy but has an easy going and laid back nature, very friendly meeting new people. He loves being out and about, going to the vet and travelling in the car. He just loves the kids 7 and 11 years old, and loves to go on walks with them. He is very good on the lead. Sherman is respectful of the household cat and is not quite sure what to make of the Maltese but just follows him around anyway! Very curious and inquisitive. Sherman loves playtime, pats, walks and new adventures. He's would be suited to a family with not toddlers but slightly older kids to grow up with or a couple with someone working from home. He will be a beautiful, loveable companion and what a wonderful journey to have the chance to grow with this happy young lad. 🐾🐾

NAME: Bozo
TEXT: Bozo is a tall, shy, and gentle boy. He might be big and tall but he has a quiet, soft and wise personality. If you're looking for a very gentle giant, who loves to lean on you and look up at you with puppy dog eyes, Bozo is the perfect match. Bozo is such a gentleman, especially around other dogs. He is a calm, reserved boy who would suit a home who can build up his confidence. A quiet, understanding owner who is interested in helping shy dogs become the best confident version of themselves, would be the perfect fit for our gentle giant, Bozo. Come and meet him at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Skinney
TEXT: Hi, I'm Skinney, I'm a cute young boy with cute markings! I walk nicely on the lead and can be shy when I first meet you. I promise I'll be your new best friend once we get to know eachother! As for what my perfect forever home looks like, I'd love a kind and gentle home, just like me. Maybe some older kids to throw ball, and a small yard to call my own? I could also live with a gentle likeminded doggie friend the same size as me. I'm a really sweet gentle boy, come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Owen
TEXT: Ohh - it's OWEN! Owen is a calm and sweet boy, gentle and confident boy. He is soft and loving around other dogs including small dogs and would be happy to join a multi-dog household. This lovely gentle lad is all things laid back - non jumpy, calm and soft natured. Owen would prefer a townhouse/courtyard to call his own and would suit many home types due to his absolutely lovely personality! Available at Western Sydney Londonderry adoption centre!

NAME: Stories
TEXT: Meet Stories 🐾 💕 Say hello to Stories, a sweet and affectionate girl who's ready to begin her next chapter—with you! This friendly lady is a total social butterfly who gets along beautifully with both dogs and cats. She’s always happy to make new friends and brings a gentle, joyful energy wherever she goes. Stories loves her toys 🎾, adores her treats 🍖, and soaks up affection like sunshine ☀️. Whether she’s having a play session or just leaning in for cuddles, she’s happiest when she’s close to her humans. If you’re looking for a loving companion who’s good with all creatures and full of fun and affection, Stories could be the perfect addition to your family. Let her bring some love—and a few tail wags—into your life!

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Meet Daisy 🌸🐾 She is a gentle and loving girl who’s ready to find her forever home. With her soft nature and kind eyes, Daisy will quickly win your heart. This lovely girl gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes, and she’s a great little traveller—calm and content on car rides. She also walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls with her a breeze. Daisy can be a bit nervous in new environments, so she’s looking for a quiet, calm home 🏡 where she can feel safe and settle in at her own pace. Once she’s comfortable, she truly shines—especially when there are pats and cuddles on offer. She's a sweetheart who just needs a little time and a lot of love. 🌼

NAME: Sam
TEXT: Say Hello to Sam 🐶 Meet Sam, a sweet and easy-going boy with a playful heart and a gentle soul. This chilled-out pup is looking for a loving home where he can share his big heart—and maybe a few treats! Sam is fantastic with children and gets along well with other dogs, making him a great fit for a family home. Whether he's lounging around or engaging in a game, Sam is happiest when he's with his humans—no matter their size! He’s got a playful side and loves to be involved in the fun, but he also enjoys a nap in a sunny spot. Treats are a big motivator for this handsome guy, and his friendly, happy nature makes him a joy to have around. If you're looking for a relaxed but playful companion who gets along with everyone and loves being part of the family, Sam might be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Zane
TEXT: Say hello to Zane! 🐾 Say hi to Zane, a lovable boy with a bright personality and a constantly wagging tail! Zane is the kind of dog who takes life in stride—always happy, always friendly, and ready to make new friends wherever he goes. Zane gets along beautifully with dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether he’s meeting other Greyhounds or mingling with different breeds, he’s calm, polite, and loves being part of the action. Busy environments? No problem for Zane! He takes everything in with a relaxed attitude and copes well with new places, people, and experiences. He’s curious, confident, and always up for a new adventure—especially if there are treats involved (his favourite!). Zane would thrive in a home where he gets to be part of the fun and share his joy with others. If you’re after a gentle, friendly companion who brings sunshine wherever he goes, Zane might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Sambo
TEXT: Meet Sambo!! Say hello to Sambo, a handsome boy with a heart as big as his stride. This lovely boy is looking for his forever home, ideally somewhere with pet-savvy people who understand his unique charm. Sambo travels like a pro and is always up for a road trip, settling in quickly whether it’s a short drive or a longer journey. He can be a bit strong on the lead when he first sets off (he's just excited!), but he settles down nicely once he gets going. Friendly and affectionate, Sambo enjoys meeting people and absolutely loves pats. He’ll happily lean in for attention and affection. He's great with medium to large dogs and enjoys the solo life with his humans. If you’re looking for a gentle soul who’s ready to settle into pet life, Sambo might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Kenny
TEXT: Meet Kenny 🐾🎾 Kenny is a sweet, happy-go-lucky Greyhound who’s always up for fun and affection. He adores children, gets along great with other dogs, and has a playful side—especially when toys are involved! This laid-back boy is also a big fan of pats and gentle attention from his humans. While Kenny can take a little time to settle into new environments, once he feels at home, his loving and easy-going personality truly shines. He travels well in the car and is happy to go with the flow, whether that means playtime, walk time, or just hanging out by your side. If you're looking for a gentle companion who brings joy, fun, and a whole lot of love, Kenny could be your perfect match. He cannot wait to be your new best mate💙

NAME: Max
TEXT: Introducing Max 🐾 Max is a handsome, independent greyhound with a calm and loving nature. He absolutely adores children and lives happily in a family home—he’s patient, gentle, and always up for a cuddle or a quiet companion by his side. Max gets along wonderfully with other dogs, making him a great fit for homes with canine companions. He's also a dream travel buddy, settling down comfortably during car rides, whether it's a quick trip to the park or a weekend getaway. While Max enjoys affection and time with his humans, he’s also perfectly content to have some quiet time alone, making him a great match for those looking for a balanced, low-maintenance friend. If you're looking for a loyal, kid-friendly, and easy going dog with a heart full of love, Max might just be your perfect match. 💙

NAME: Chloe
TEXT: Meet Chloe — the confident, friendly tail-wagger who loves her doggy pals! 🐾💖 Chloe is a happy-go-lucky greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger tail — because she just can’t stop wagging when she’s around other dogs! 🐕💨 She already lives with a small dog and absolutely loves having furry friends to share her days with. With her confident and friendly personality, Chloe is always ready to say hello, make new friends, and spread good vibes wherever she goes. Whether she’s meeting new pups on a walk or chilling at home with her canine buddy, she’s a true social butterfly. 🦋🐶 If you’re looking for a cheerful, outgoing greyhound who adores company and knows how to make friends easily, Chloe is the perfect match!

NAME: Garth
TEXT: Introducing Garth… 🐾✨ Garth is a clever, confident greyhound who is happy to sniff out the world around him. 🌍👃 Whether it’s a leafy park, a busy street, or a quiet trail, Garth’s nose is always on a mission. He’s got a serious sniff game going on, taking in all in. But don’t let his independent streak fool you — when it’s time to wind down, Garth transforms into a total cuddle champ. 🥰 He’s a pro at snuggling up close, giving the best warm, cozy vibes after a long day of exploring. 🐕❤️ On walks, Garth is the perfect gentleman: calm, focused, and walking nicely on the lead. 🐕‍🦺 He’s happy to take the lead on where to sniff next, but always by your side. If you’re after a smart, easy-going companion who loves his independence but knows how to share the love, Garth is your guy and he can’t wait to meet you! 💙

NAME: Canya
TEXT: Canya is a cute guy, happy to settle where ever and go with the flow. He walks nice on lead, happy around new people and happy wagging tail where ever he goes. Canya would enjoy an outdoor area to call his home whether that's a courtyard or backyard. Super friendly and easy going, Canya would happily join a family with children or other dogs. He will lean on you and be forever grateful and love you forever for the adventures and treats that come his way! Canya is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Benny
TEXT: B-B-B-B-Benny and the Pets! Benny is calm around other dogs and would be happy to live with a big or small dog pal. He travels well in the car, and happy to sniff and explore new places with you. He's laid back and happy to go with the flow. A backyard/townhouse would be best suited so he has some outdoor space to call his own. He’s a sucker for the occasional Elton John ballad playing in the background while he naps. Adopt Benny and get front row seats to unconditional love. Benny is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rosko
TEXT: Sniff sniff sniff....you seem like the perfect person for me! I'm Rosko, a calm, laid back boy. I'm friendly, happy go lucky and would love to be by your side for adventures to come! I'm described as really lovely, and i hopr you agree! I don't mind if I have another dog pal in my home, or even those little people you call children. I am a delight to have around and I hope you pick me to adopt! I can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre. See you soon!

NAME: Sadie
TEXT: Say hello to Sadie! 🌸 Sadie is a cool, calm, and confident greyhound who knows exactly what she wants out of life — and that includes plenty of chill time 😌. She’s an independent lady who’s perfectly happy entertaining herself with a comfy bed 🛏️, a toy or two 🎾, and a quiet corner to call her own. She would suit a household with full time workers or with another chilled out dog. Relaxed and self-assured, Sadie takes new experiences in her stride. If you're looking for a low-maintenance companion who brings a calm presence and quiet charm into your home, Sadie could be the perfect fit 🐾💕

NAME: Shakey
TEXT: Meet Shakey! 🐾 Shakey is a lovable greyhound with a heart full of affection for humans and fellow dogs alike❤️. Always the initiator of cuddles and belly rubs, Shakey thrives on connection and companionship. Curious and adventurous, he loves exploring new surroundings and enjoys every walk — especially because he’s such a pro on the lead! 🚶‍♂️ He’d be happiest in a busy, lively home where there’s plenty going on and would be more than happy with another furry friend to share the fun 🐕🎉. If you’re looking for a gentle, sociable, and well-mannered greyhound to brighten your days, Shakey might just shake her way into being your perfect match!

NAME: Murphy
TEXT: Murphy would love a backyard to perfect the greyhound zoomies in! He has a love for treats and fun times, and would fit in well with a family who enjoy an active, outgoing boy to spoil like the king he is! Murphy is still learning lots about the world and would suit an experienced owner who can help Murphy learn about the world around him. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Max
TEXT: Max is a beautiful dog who enjoys his days lazing around the backyard with his two older female greyhound friends. Max is smaller sized for a male weighing only 29kg Max is a great companion and would be perfect for a family with another large dog for him to be friends with. Max has been socialised around younger school age children and happily plays in the backyard with them. Max would make a great addition to your home and is perfect for full-time workers with a companion to hang with during the day

NAME: Tina
TEXT: Tina is a beautiful girl in her golden years. This golden lady is ready to snooze on your couch, receive treats for being a princess, and accompany you on trots around the block. She's sweet and affectionate by nature and loves all the humans she meets while she's out and about! Tina has shown to do well indoors which means an apartment, unit or townhouse could be where Tina finds her forever home. Tina is a sweet and gentle girl who can't wait to meet you. Despite not yet having been a pet, Tina has all the love to give, and is eager to learn along side you all the spoils of pet life! A home without other dogs is best for Tina as she knows she is a queen who deserves all your love! Golden girl Tina is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Cody
TEXT: Cody is a fun, confident boy. affectionate and energetic boy. Cody would suit a backyard or townhouse for his daily zoomies! Cody is happy to live with another cat, dog big or small and has experience with little kids, too. Cody will happily show off his skills like being able to jump in and out of cars unassisted, and of course his puppy dog eyes...! Cody is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Meet Tiger! 🐾 Tiger is a sleek, affectionate greyhound with a heart as big as his zoomies! Don’t let the name fool you—this gentle boy is all love and no roar. Tiger absolutely adores water, whether it’s splashing in a kiddie pool or enjoying a walk by the lake. His playful, outgoing nature makes him a hit with other dogs, and his excitement around children is infectious—he's always ready to make a new little friend! Tiger thrives in social settings and is happiest when he's part of the action. He loves cuddles just as much as he loves exploring, and his sweet, affectionate personality shines through in everything he does. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Tiger might just be your perfect match. 🐶💦❤️

NAME: Tommy
TEXT: Meet Tommy – The Tail-Wagging Bundle of Joy! 🐾🎉 Tommy is a happy greyhound whose tail never stops wagging! He’s a lovable guy who thrives on cuddles, pats, and playtime—always ready to share his infectious enthusiasm with everyone he meets. Tommy loves exploring new places and sniffing out adventures, making every walk an exciting journey. His joyful spirit and affectionate nature make him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a fun-loving, loving friend. If you want a happy, playful pal who’s always up for a cuddle and a romp, Tommy’s your guy!

NAME: Spook
TEXT: Meet Spook – Your Loyal, Cuddly Companion 🖤🐾 Spook is a gentle greyhound with a loving heart and a soft spot for cuddles. He gets along beautifully with both cats and dogs, making him a great addition to a multi-pet home. Spook would be perfectly suited to a retired person or someone who works from home—he loves having company and will happily curl up beside you while you go about your day. Calm, affectionate, and easy to please, Spook’s happiest moments are spent close to the people he loves. If you're after a quiet, cuddly companion who’ll be your shadow in the best way, Spook is ready to find his forever home with you.

NAME: Pam
TEXT: Meet Pam – A Gentle Heart Looking for a Quiet Home 💗🐾 Pam is a soft-natured and gentle greyhound with a truly loving soul. She adores affection and will melt into you for cuddles, often leaning in for pats and staying close to soak up every bit of love. Calm and sensitive, Pam would thrive in a quiet household where she can feel settled. She’s the kind of companion who will quietly be by your side, offering comfort and warmth with her gentle presence. A perfect pup for someone looking for a new bestie. Pam will make a great companion inside and outside the house. She walks beautifully on the lead during adventures. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate girl who just wants a peaceful place to call home, Pam is ready to give you her heart.

NAME: Snow
