TEXT: Meet Snow – A Cool Customer with a Warm Heart! ❄️🐾 Snow is a calm and confident greyhound who just needs a little time to warm up – but once he does, his friendly and happy nature truly shines. With a relaxed personality and an easygoing charm, Snow is the perfect companion for anyone looking for a laid-back friend with a steady heart. He walks beautifully on the lead and takes the world in his stride, showing quiet confidence wherever he goes. Whether he’s lounging in the sun or enjoying a gentle stroll, Snow brings a peaceful, positive presence to every moment. If you're after a loyal, chilled-out pal who’ll reward your patience with love and companionship, Snow is ready to melt your heart.

NAME: Duke
TEXT: Meet Duke – Your New Best Mate! 🐾👑 Duke is a bright and curious greyhound who’s always ready for his next adventure! With his engaging personality and zest for life, Duke makes friends wherever he goes. He absolutely lights up around new people—his tail wags, his ears perk up, and he can’t wait to say hello! Duke is also a smart cookie with impressive recall, making him a joy to take on adventures. He can be strong on the lead at times, especially when he's excited to explore, so he'll do best with someone confident and steady on walks. Whether he's exploring new places or snuggling up for a quiet moment, Duke brings a perfect mix of excitement and affection. If you’re after a fun, friendly, and loyal companion who’s always up for a meet-and-greet, Duke’s your guy!

NAME: Ollie
TEXT: Say Hello to Ollie! 🐶💛 Ollie is a charming greyhound with a cute, chilled-out personality and a constantly wagging tail that shows just how happy he is to be around you! He’s grown up around pocket pets and knows how to be gentle with the little ones, making him a great fit for a home with pocket size animals. While Ollie is laid-back and affectionate, he does have a bit of strength when out and about—so he’ll need someone confident on the lead to match his enthusiasm for walks. Whether he's lounging around the house or exploring the great outdoors, Ollie brings a calm, happy energy wherever he goes. If you're looking for a sweet-natured, tail-wagging companion, Ollie could be your perfect match!

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: Meet Alfie! 🐾 Alfie is a handsome greyhound with a heart as big as his paws! This sociable guy adores the company of humans and loves making new friends—especially the big dog kind! With his bubbly personality and relaxed nature, Alfie is the perfect companion for a family looking for a gentle, easy-going friend. He’s fantastic with children, walks beautifully on the lead, and brings a calm, happy presence wherever he goes. Whether he's lounging in the sun or trotting alongside you on a stroll, Alfie is just happy to be part of the fun. If you're looking for a sweet, social pup with a heart of gold, Alfie’s your guy! 💛

NAME: Ray
TEXT: This handsome boy is a Ray of Sunshine🌤️ Ray is the total package! Social, sweet and confident. He absolutely loves meeting new people and greets everyone like an old friend! Ray walks well on lead and loves to explore, so he wouldn't mind joining you for an adventure. He gets along well with other dogs of all sizes too! So he would'nt mind sharing his new home with a friend or two, pending a meet and greet. If you're looking for a loving companion who will brighten your days, Ray is ready to light up your life! Meet him at Western Sydney.

NAME: Falcone
TEXT: Meet Falcone 🐾!! Falcone is a striking greyhound with an independent streak and a relaxed outlook on life. He’s the kind of dog who’s happy in his own company but still enjoys a good walk and the occasional scratch behind the ears. This low-maintenance lad walks beautifully on the lead and loves a calm stroll where he can stretch his legs and take in the world at his own pace. Falcone gets along well with other large dogs and would be a great match for a home with a laid-back canine companion. Thanks to his independent nature, Falcone is well-suited to full-time workers – he’s content to chill out during the day and will greet you with quiet affection when you return home. If you’re looking for a relaxed and reliable mate to share your life with, Falcone might just be the one for you.

NAME: Donald
TEXT: Meet Donald – The Laid-Back Explorer 🐾🌿 If you're after a cool, calm, and collected companion, look no further than Donald. This distinguished greyhound has a relaxed nature and prefers to take life at a steady pace, one sniff at a time. Donald walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys leisurely strolls where he can take in all the sights and smells around him. He’s got a curious nose and an independent spirit, perfectly content doing his own thing while staying close to his trusted humans. He gets along well with larger dogs and would be happy sharing space with a chilled-out canine friend. Donald isn’t overly needy – he enjoys affection but also appreciates his alone time and would thrive in a calm, low-key home. If you’re looking for a gentle soul with a quiet confidence and a love for life’s simple pleasures, Donald might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Bruiser
TEXT: Meet Bruiser – Big Heart, Bigger Tail Wags! 🐶💕 Don’t let the name fool you – Bruiser is a total softie! This happy-go-lucky boy is bursting with love and has a tail that never stops wagging. He’s always ready to greet you with a smile and a nuzzle, and he thrives on affection from his human friends. Bruiser is full of energy and enjoys his playtime, walks, and any chance to explore the world by your side. He’s been around children aged 8 and up and would do well in a home where he can continue building those bonds – he loves being part of the action! Whether it’s zoomies in the yard or cuddles on the couch, Bruiser brings a joyful spark to every moment. He’d be a wonderful match for an active family or anyone looking for a loyal, loving companion. Ready to meet your new best friend? Bruiser can’t wait to wag his way into your heart!

NAME: Maggie
TEXT: Meet Maggie – Your Future Snuggle Buddy! 🐾 Say hello to Maggie, a sweet and gentle greyhound with a heart full of love and legs made for graceful strolls. This lovely girl is as affectionate as they come – she absolutely adores pats, cuddles, and being close to her people. Maggie is a dream on the lead and makes every walk a pleasure. She gets along well with other dogs and would happily share her space with a canine friend. Whether it’s a walk around the block or a cozy nap on the couch, Maggie is content just being near those she loves. While Maggie can be redirected around cats, she still needs a bit more work and supervision in that area, so a cat-free home would be best. If you're looking for a calm, cuddly companion who will melt into your side and brighten your days, Maggie might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Opal
TEXT: Meet Opal! 🌟 Opal is a sweet and spirited greyhound with a heart full of joy and a tail that never stops wagging. She’s a social butterfly who absolutely loves playing with other dogs — big or small, young or old, Opal makes fast friends with everyone she meets. She’s wonderful with children and has a gentle, easygoing nature that makes her a perfect companion for families. Opal has spent some time living indoors, so she's already familiar with home life and enjoys the comforts of a cozy bed and a sunny window spot. Happy, affectionate, and always up for some fun, Opal is ready to bring love, laughter, and a little extra zoom to her forever home. 💕

NAME: Apollo
TEXT: Apollo is looking for a nurturing owner who he can trust, so he can build a bond and thrive. Despite being initially reserved, he is a very gentle boy. He really wants to bond with you, we've learnt this takes time and patience, and is very rewarding! If you are an understanding and gentle person, Apollo would love to be guided by you into the big wide world. Apollo really opens up around other greyhounds, and suits a fun loving dog by his side. It makes our hearts so full to see him having fun with another greyhound! If you have a home with an understanding canine companion, Apollo would love to meet them. A home without children is best suited, and a house with a yard to retreat to is best suited. He shows he's comfortable inside on the couch, so indoor/outdoor access throughout the day would be best. If you have a calm lifestyle, looking for a companion to help guide into the big wide world, consider adopting Apollo. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Job
TEXT: Meet Job 🐾 He is a lovable greyhound with a heart full of affection ❤️. He adores children 👧🧒 and gets along wonderfully with other dogs 🐶, making him a true family favourite. With his very easy-going personality, Job loves nothing more than cuddles and relaxing moments with his people. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving companion who’s great with kids and furry friends alike, Job is the perfect match! 🐕✨

NAME: Everest
TEXT: *I'm in a foster care home with a male greyhound and a male jack russell - check in soon to see what I'm up to* With a salt and pepper face and a gentle demeanour, Everest is the kind of greyhound you will so easily fall in love with. Everest has all your quintessential greyhound quirks whether that's a moment of zoomies, a biiiiig lean on your leg for cuddles, and not forgetting the sweetest eyes which will melt your heart. Everest is an easy going old chap, with an adaptable, gentle and understanding nature. He just wants to curl up beside you and go out for a trot around the block when you're ready, waiting patiently by your side during the day. He is super sweet and calm. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Sonny
TEXT: Sonny is a gentle, easy-going boy with a calm and placid nature. He loves a good snuggle but is just as happy doing his own thing or spending time with his people. With a slow introduction, he may get along well with smaller dogs and cats. Sonny is a relaxed companion ready to bring quiet joy to a loving home.

NAME: Connery
TEXT: Connery is a happy, playful, and confident boy who loves to be social and stay engaged with his surroundings. He’s full of energy and would enjoy playing with children and having a backyard to explore. With a slow introduction, he may do well with smaller dogs and cats. Connery is ready to bring fun and joy to his future family!

NAME: Jonas
TEXT: Jonas is a sweet and affectionate female with a curious heart. She enjoys spending time with people—perfect for part-time workers or anyone home often—and does well with children. Jonas would thrive in a supportive, patient home that gives her the space and encouragement to grow. She gets along with medium-sized dogs and may do well with cats given a slow, gentle introduction. With time and love, Jonas will blossom into a loyal and joyful companion.

NAME: Inex
TEXT: Say hello to Inex! 🐶 Inex is a playful and independent greyhound who loves nothing more than a good romp around the yard. Whether she's chasing toys or just stretching her legs, outdoor time is her favourite time! She gets along brilliantly with other dogs and is very well-mannered on the lead, making walks with her an absolute pleasure. Inex also has a wonderfully independent streak—she’s happy doing her own thing but still enjoys the company of her people and furry friends. If you’re looking for a confident, fun-loving greyhound who’s easy to walk and great with other dogs, Inex could be your perfect match!

NAME: Tina
TEXT: Meet Tina, a sweet and gentle soul who is quietly searching for a loving and understanding new family. Although shy at first, Tina blossoms in a calm and serene environment where she can feel safe and secure. She's perfect for a household looking for a quieter canine companion who will gently match their pace and lifestyle. Tina gets along well with other dogs, making her a great addition if you already have canine family members. Tina has been socialised with children and actually likes little people who are polite and dog savvy. While Tina may initially be more reserved, she is eager to find a foster home to help her ease into her new life. This gradual adjustment allows her to grow in confidence and fully show off her lovely personality and sweet demeanor. If you can offer Tina a foster home so she can settle into pet life please contact us, we would love to find her someone to celebrate her 3rd birthday with.

NAME: Victor
TEXT: Meet Victor! 🐾 Victor is a quiet and calm greyhound who loves the simple pleasures in life. He has a soft spot for chickens and gets along wonderfully with other dogs, making him a peaceful and friendly companion. Victor adores affection and enjoys gentle cuddles and quiet moments with his favourite humans. If you’re looking for a loving, easy going dog who brings calm and warmth to your home, Victor is the perfect match.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! 🐾 Charlie is a social butterfly who loves spending time with people and gets along great with other dogs. He’s full of energy and can be a bit strong on the lead at first, but he quickly settles into a calm and well-mannered walker once he gets going. Charlie is also a pro traveller—he enjoys van rides and is comfortable on the road, making him a great adventure buddy. If you’re looking for a friendly, outgoing greyhound who’s ready to join you on walks and trips, Charlie is your guy!

NAME: Miesha
TEXT: Say hello to Miesha! 💕 Miesha is a stunning greyhound girl with a heart full of joy and a love for life! She's a star in the kennels—calm, clean, and easy to care for. This beautiful girl loves swimming and will happily splash around at any opportunity. She’s clever too, and comes running when you call her name, especially if there’s a toy involved! Miesha is a playful soul who adores her toys and often carries one proudly wherever she goes. She gets along brilliantly with other dogs and is a dream to walk—calm, polite, and great on the lead. With her gentle nature and happy energy, Socks is sure to brighten every day.

NAME: Socks
TEXT: Meet Socks! 🐾 Socks is a gentle and affectionate greyhound with a heart as big as his appetite! This food-loving boy is as patient as he is sweet, always waiting his turn with a calm and easy going nature. Whether he’s lounging quietly or greeting new friends, Socks is a total sweetheart who gets along wonderfully with other dogs. His friendly personality makes him a joy to have around, and he’s sure to steal your heart (and maybe a treat or two!).

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack – The Polite Gentleman with a Heart of Gold 💛🐾 Jack is a calm, easygoing greyhound who’s as lovely on the inside as he is on the outside. With his gentle nature and relaxed attitude, he settles into new environments quickly and takes everything in his stride. Jack is fantastic with children and other dogs, making him a wonderful family companion. He’s always polite, friendly, and happy to be part of the group – whether it’s a quiet day at home or a walk around the neighbourhood. He walks beautifully on the lead, never pulling or fussing, and is more than happy to stroll along at your side. Jack’s chilled-out personality and kind soul make him a joy to have around.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Meet Billy – The Quiet Charmer with a Playful Side 🎾🐾 Billy is a gentle, independent greyhound with a lovely calm nature and just the right amount of playfulness. He’s not one to demand constant attention, but he’s always nearby with a quiet presence and a soft heart. Billy gets along beautifully with small dogs and is respectful and friendly in their company. He also enjoys a bit of solo playtime with his toys – give him a squeaky or something to toss around, and he’s one happy hound. This laid-back boy values his own space and is content to relax on his own, making him a great companion for someone who appreciates a more independent pet. He’s the kind of dog who slots effortlessly into your routine without any fuss.

NAME: Pheonix
TEXT: Meet Phoenix – The Laid-Back Legend with a Love for Pats 🚐🐾 Phoenix is a cool, confident greyhound who takes life in his stride – quite literally! He walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys a good stroll by your side, always calm and well-mannered. This clever boy is also super practical – he can hop in and out of a van all by himself, making outings and adventures a breeze. Whether it’s a trip to the park or a drive to somewhere new, Phoenix is always up for the ride. Phoenix is a big fan of affection and never says no to a pat or a gentle scratch – he’ll happily lean in for more! He’s also friendly with other dogs and enjoys their company, making him a great fit for homes with existing pets.

NAME: Greg
TEXT: Meet Greg – A Gentle Soul Ready to Bloom 🌟🐾 Greg is a sweet and sensitive greyhound with a quietly charming personality. He can be a little shy at first, but it doesn’t take long for him to warm up – and once he does, you’ll see a loving and loyal companion who enjoys being part of the action in his own gentle way. Greg gets along well with other dogs and enjoys their company. He walks beautifully on the lead and is a dream to take out and about, always calm and well-mannered. He also travels well in the car, making adventures easy and stress-free. With a little patience and a lot of love, Greg will continue to come out of his shell and show you just how affectionate and easy going he really is. He’s a quiet star who’s just waiting for the right person or family to help him shine.

NAME: Sheila
TEXT: Meet Sheila – A Sweet Soul with a Playful Heart 🐾💖 Sheila is a beautiful greyhound with a gentle nature and a heart full of love. She can be a little shy when meeting new people or exploring new places, but give her a bit of time and patience, and you’ll see her blossom into a joyful, playful girl with the happiest little tail wags. Once Sheila feels safe and settled, her playful side shines through. She loves to run, bounce around, and enjoy the company of her doggy friends – she gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in their company. Sheila would do best in a calm and supportive home where she’s given the space to build her confidence. In return, she’ll reward you with sweet affection, gentle playfulness, and a loyal heart.

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Meet Penny – The Playful Ball-Chasing Queen! 🎾🐾 Penny is a bright, bubbly greyhound with a zest for life and a serious love for fetch! Toss a ball and watch her light up with joy – she could play all day if you let her. Her playful spirit and happy nature make her an absolute delight to be around. Always cheerful and full of personality, Penny brings positive energy wherever she goes. She travels well in the car, making her a great companion for outings and adventures, and she’s perfectly content relaxing in her crate when it’s time to wind down. Penny is the perfect mix of fun and easy going. Whether she’s chasing a ball, enjoying a ride, or snoozing in her crate after a busy day, she does it all with a wagging tail and a happy heart.

NAME: Glen
TEXT: Meet Glen – The Ultimate Companion with a Heart of Gold 💛🐾 Glen is a handsome greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger love for life. Friendly, affectionate, and full of charm, Glen adores people and never misses an opportunity for a cuddle or a kind word. His tail is always wagging, especially when he's surrounded by his favourite humans. Glen gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is a real social butterfly. Whether he's playing with his pals or just chilling nearby, he brings calm, friendly energy wherever he goes. A big fan of toys, Glen loves a bit of playtime and will happily keep himself entertained with a squeaky or two. He also travels like a dream in the car, making him the perfect buddy for road trips, weekend getaways, or even just a quick drive to the park.

NAME: Donnie
TEXT: Meet Donnie – The Social Butterfly with a Love for Fun! 🐶🎾 Donnie is a happy-go-lucky greyhound who’s always up for a good time! Whether he’s heading out on a road trip or making new doggy friends at the park, Donnie takes it all in stride. He travels like a pro – calm, relaxed, and ready for the next stop on the journey. This playful boy has a soft spot for toys and will happily entertain himself with a squeaky or a tug toy, bringing a smile to everyone around him. He gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in social settings, making him a great fit for families with existing canine companions. Donnie walks beautifully on the lead and loves exploring the world at a comfortable pace by your side. His friendly nature, confidence, and zest for life make him a joy to have around.

NAME: Dougall
TEXT: Meet Dougall – Your Future Travel Buddy! 🚗🐾 Dougall is a charming greyhound with a heart as big as his love for car rides. This gentle soul is always ready to hop in the car and join you on your next adventure – whether it’s a weekend getaway or just a trip to the shops, Dougall’s happy place is right by your side. With excellent leash manners, Dougall walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls a breeze. He’s polite and friendly around other dogs, and his calm nature makes him a wonderful companion in a variety of settings. Dougall also has a soft spot for affection. He’ll happily lean in for a cuddle or nuzzle up for some ear scratches – he may be sleek and speedy, but he’s really just a big softie at heart.

NAME: Obi Wan Kenobi
TEXT: This is Obi-Wan Kenobi, a brave Jedi knight. He harnesses the use of the force to steal hearts across the adoption centre. What do we love about Obi? Read on... Obi-Wan Kenobi gets super excited and might even do a little happy dance when he sees his lead as he loves walkies and adventures, making him a great fit for an adventurous family who enjoy long walks through the galaxy. He is perfect indoors with no accidents here at the GAP adoption centre. His preferred home would be a house with some yard space as he enjoys the freedom to do as he pleases! If you're looking for a cutie to binge some Star Wars eps with, Obi-Wan Kenobi might be the perfect fit. He is gentle, affectionate and loves lazing on the couch and has the quintessential greyhound personality of lazy bones mixed with moments of playfulness. Obi-Wan Kenobi seeks a family who will respect his Jedi calmness but also embrace his playful side. He’s suited for homes with a peaceful vibe and a little space to run free like a Rebel. Meet Obi at the Western Sydney adoption centre and "May the paws be with you"!

NAME: Rocky (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Rocky, the underdog coming through to take the spotlight of a home! This boy has no trouble leading his way through our kennels to find his next victory. Rocky is a very handsome lad that doesn’t mind spending time with children and frolicking in a backyard/townhouse as he has experience around kids. Rocky would walk best on a harness as he is excited to get going. Rocky is available to adopt from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Fig
TEXT: Say hello to our adorable Fig! Fig is a certified people-person in dog form who thrives on attention, affection, and the occasional belly rub. If you’re home more often than not, Fig will be your best friend, your cuddle buddy, and your biggest fan. He’s got great recall and walks like a dream on the leash, so he’s always up for a stroll, as long as it’s by your side. Figgy is hoping his new owner has a backyard in a quiet neighbourhood for him for zoomies & to take a nap on the grass in the sunshine. Playful and full of life, Figgy boy loves to let loose in a yard. He gets on well with other medium/large dogs and older kids are also fine by him. Dress ups, fun and games are all his cup of tea. He will have the kids entertained all day. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who’s as happy sprinting as he is snuggling, Figgy might be your perfect match. If Fig sounds just simply delicious to you, apply to adopt online today!

NAME: Chester
TEXT: Chester is a strapping boy, he is calm and confident. He is comfortable in the yard on his own and can be left alone. He knows his name and comes when called. He is very trainable and compliant. He is very patient and comfortable on the lead and is comfortable being walked in busy areas/noisy roads etc.

NAME: Stavros
TEXT: Stavros is a beautiful boy that’s full of love and life! He has spent the last few months in a foster care home with 6 other dogs of all shapes and sizes. Stavros would be best suited to a home with 1 other doggie friend. 6 was fun, but he's about quality, not quantity! If Stavros lives as your only dog, shorter hours alone are preferred. With a doggie pal to keep him company, you can go off to work during the day and he'll be happy with the canine company he has. Stavros is fond of a run around and play time but also loves giving and receiving lots of affection. An adults only home is the best fit for this gentle giant. He has a playful side and loves to have fun! Stavros would be a great addition to an apartment home (with lift access - no stairs) with an active lifestyle, or a house with a yard. Stavros is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Uno
TEXT: Uno is a sweet-natured, gentle girl with a calm and placid demeanor. She may be a little shy at first, but with patience and a supportive home, she’ll blossom beautifully. Uno does well with kind, understanding children and gets along with smaller dogs. With a slow and careful introduction, she may also do well with cats. Uno is looking for a calm, nurturing environment where she can continue to grow in confidence and love.

NAME: Raj
TEXT: Raj is a vibrant, confident and friendly boy who would do well with a townhouse/backyard to enjoy. He does very well with other greyhounds so would happily join a multi-dog household. Raj may not be a king but he certainly has a confident personality to match his name. He has bursts of energy so would do best with children with some big dog experience. Raj has not seen much of the big wide world and would benefit from an owner who enjoys some dog training and seeing their new dog thrive under their guidance. Raj is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Eddy
TEXT: Eddy is a shy and quiet boy looking for a nurturing home to thrive in. He warms up with those he's confident with and would do best with a backyard for his zoomies when the mood strikes. Eddy hasn't seen a lot of the world yet and would thrive with a home who is looking to take it slow with him to build his confidence. Eddy can't wait to meet you and become a beloved family pet! Eddy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Beau
TEXT: Beau is a confident, happy-go-lucky boy bursting with puppy-like energy and a love for life! Playful and engaging, he’s always up for a game or some quality time with his people—and he’s never short on tail wags. Beau would thrive in a home with another medium to large dog who can match his energy and playful nature. He’s full of enthusiasm on walks and can be strong on the lead, so a family with older kids who can keep up with his strength and spirit would be ideal. If you're after a fun-loving, social companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Beau is ready to be your new best mate!

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a happy, confident boy with a playful heart and a relaxed outlook on life. He’s the kind of dog who’s just as content having a romp around the yard as he is chilling out by your side, soaking up cuddles and pats (his favourite!). Jimmy walks with enthusiasm and might be a bit strong on the lead at times, but with a bit of practice, he’ll settle into a great walking buddy. He could potentially get along with smaller dogs too, given slow and careful introductions—he’s a sociable guy who just likes to take his time getting to know new friends. If you're after a cheerful, affectionate companion with a lovely balance of energy and calm, Jimmy could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Cooper
TEXT: Cooper is a confident, cheeky boy with a playful spark and a big personality! He’s always up for fun, whether it’s a run around the yard, a good game with a doggy mate, or heading out on an adventure. He’d thrive in an active home, especially one with another dog around his size to keep him company and match his energy. Cooper’s zest for life is infectious — he’s the kind of dog who’ll keep you laughing and moving, then happily crash for a nap once the fun’s over. If you’re looking for a playful, social, and slightly cheeky companion, Cooper could be your perfect adventure buddy!

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: Reggie is a relaxed and independent boy who’s all about the quiet life. He enjoys a bit of company and is happy to hang out with you, but he’s equally content doing his own thing — the perfect companion for someone who appreciates a low-key, easy-going dog. He does pull a little on the lead (there’s just so much to sniff!), so he’ll need a bit of guidance when it comes to walks. But with a patient and gentle hand, Reggie will soon settle into a lovely routine. If you’re looking for a calm, undemanding friend to share peaceful days with, Reggie might be your perfect match.

NAME: Jj
TEXT: JJ is a sweet, happy-go-lucky boy with the playful energy of a puppy and a heart full of love. Confident and full of charm, he’s always ready for fun — whether that’s a zoom around the garden or a goofy game with his canine pals. He’s still working on his lead manners (he’s just so excited to explore!), but with a bit of guidance, he’ll be strutting like a pro in no time. JJ might be cat-workable, but he’s definitely more in his element around other greyhounds or larger dogs. In fact, he’d thrive in a home with a doggy friend to play with and help show him the ropes. If you’re looking for a cheerful, fun-loving companion with a heart of gold, JJ is your guy!

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Angel is a confident, people-loving girl who can’t resist a good cuddle session — she’s basically a professional snuggle expert. When she’s excited, she does a happy little prance that’s guaranteed to brighten your day. She walks beautifully on lead and is always ready to be your loyal companion, whether you’re a busy family or flying solo. She is also happy to travel with you if you like a good road trip. Angel would suit a household who have other M/L dogs and children that are happy to play with her. If you don’t have any pint-sized pooches or sneaky cats, Angel is all in for a lifetime of love and fun! This girl always has her tail wagging around her favourite humans, bounding around and exploring the world are just two of her favourite things to do.

NAME: Barba
TEXT: Barba is a beautiful boy who loves adventure. Barba would be ideal for the young professional couple or single person looking to give a dog a structured life. Barba whilst growing up in a residential street has limited house exposure. Barba is very good to take on longer walks and is a very good learner. Barba with the correct introduction would be good with medium to large dogs

NAME: Pop Tart (Poppy)
TEXT: Pop Tart is as sweet as her name suggests! Once a timid little girl, she’s blossomed in foster care and is growing in confidence every day. Living in an apartment hasn’t slowed her down – she loves her daily walks, tackles stairs like a pro, and has absolutely no issues with noisy roads or traffic. Pop Tart is toilet trained, playful, and incredibly affectionate. She’s happiest when tossing her toys into the air or curling up close for a cuddle after a fun play session. She’s even spent time around children and absolutely adores the company of gentle little humans. Social Skills: Calm dogs only – Pop Tart has walked nicely with small dogs and is fine with calmer canine friends Still a bit wary of bigger dogs, but there’s no aggression – just some nervous energy Would thrive either as a solo dog or with the right chill companion Comfortable around kids who are respectful and kind Ideal Home: Apartment or house – she’s flexible and used to apartment life A calm and patient environment where she can keep building her confidence Daily walks and a bit of playtime to burn off her cheeky energy A home committed to continuing her positive socialisation journey

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Roy is a 4-year-old greyhound who has grown up in a rural environment and is now looking for his forever home. He is a clean and well-mannered dog who never messes in his kennel, showing great potential for transitioning into a home environment with a little support for house training. He’s an excitable boy who enjoys a good run around but doesn’t jump up or show signs of destructive behaviour. Roy gets along well with other greyhounds and would thrive either as a solo dog or with a calm canine companion. Roy is well-suited to homes where the owners work full-time, as he is independent and relaxed when left alone. He would do best with a secure yard and regular opportunities to stretch his legs, ideally in a quiet, calm setting similar to his upbringing. Roy is a gentle, happy dog who just needs a little time and patience to adjust to home life. With the right guidance, he will make a loving and loyal companion.

NAME: Dixie
TEXT: Dixie is a 4-year-old brindle greyhound and the sister of Roy. She’s a smaller girl with a big personality, full of charm and playful energy. Dixie is a good kennel dog who keeps her space clean and enjoys a structured routine. She’s an excited little lady who absolutely loves to show off her zoomies in the yard. Despite her bursts of energy, she settles down quickly and is happy to relax once she’s had a chance to stretch her legs. Dixie would suit a family environment and is good with children aged 5 and up. She’s gentle, affectionate, and thrives on attention. With her easy-going nature and love of fun, Dixie would make a delightful addition to a home that can offer her both playtime and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Harry
TEXT: Harry is a total catch! He is friendly, confident, good with humans and dogs, and a happy bubbly boy. He likes to play, has a good food drive, showing to be very trainable, he also walks lovely on the leash. He is confident on lead and in new environments as well as super polite with our greyhounds and small dogs here at the centre. Harry is a gentle, yet playful, lovely mix of all the perfect greyhound quirks! If he's not smooching up to you, he's sniffing out the treats in your pocket or finding a toy to entertain himself with. This goofy love bug is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Henry
TEXT: Henry has lived his life surrounded by children, and would suit a home with a family of children who are eager to give him lots of love. Henry is a social butterfly who loves a bit of attention! He would suit a home with another medium to large dog who is on the chill side like him. His previous owners have summed him up as a big goof ball, who is placid, even a little bit clumsy! He settles well on his bed and is happy to watch the world go by with you by his side. Henry is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Meri
TEXT: Little 23kg Meri has been around children 1+ to 14 years old, she loves a bit of attention and loves to run off with toys and have a bit of fun. She is a friendly, confident, yet relaxed girl. Meri would enjoy a backyard/townhouse with or without a greyhound pal to spend her days with, she would also be suitable around children due to her history of exposure with kids! Meri is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ox
TEXT: Ox is the big softie that makes your heart melt. Ox is currently living inside a home learning to love the relaxed life. Ox still enjoys his walk and is a delight to walk on lead. This big guy is a kind hearted boy who loves sleeping the day away. Ox enjoys human company but is also happy to be left alone for full time working hours. Ox enjoys a car ride and lazing on his bed in your home

NAME: Carly
TEXT: Carly may take a little time to fully warm up but once she does, you'll find a wonderfully affectionate pup. Patience will reveal Carly's true nature: a loyal and cuddly grey. Carly can be apprehensive and may shy away when approached from above, but if you crouch down to her level, you'll soon discover her gentle heart and spark of curiosity. Her ideal home would be a calm environment where she can enjoy plenty of affection and cozy snuggles without feeling rushed or overwhelmed. A home with a part-time worker would be an excellent fit for Carly, as she'd benefit from having company during the day. With time, patience, and love, Carly will become an irreplaceable member of your household, full of love and ready to receive it in return.

NAME: Alf
TEXT: Alf is a handsome young male. He is destined for pet life as he is a relaxed, playful, affectionate confident boy. He loves diving into the water when he can - a true water baby! He enjoys lounging around the yard, basking in the sun and creating life long memories playing with little humans. Alf would be suited to a household with full time workers with a backyard or a family with younger children.

NAME: Diesel (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Diesel 🐾 I'm a gorgeous confident boy, ready to bring some fun to the life of my new family. I adore all humans and even grew up around children myself, making me the perfect addition to your family! I would love my new home all to myself as I thrive when I'm the only star of the show⭐ Oh and I also love to play and chase after my toys so a backyard would be great for me! If you think I could be the guy for you, come and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Kane
TEXT: Kane is a social and confident lad with a charming personality. Kane is a good traveller, enjoys spending time with other hounds and has been described as playful, fun, and very lazy! He is a wonderful blend of calm, with that perky playful side! Kane would enjoy a townhouse/backyard, and a home with or without respectful children. A family with another M-L canine companion would also be well suited to this sweet gentleman. Kane is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Prince
TEXT: Prince is a very handsome boy with a playful heart and a love for life! He’s affectionate, engaging, and always up for a game of chase with his favorite toys. Prince gets along well with smaller dogs and would be thrilled to have a yard where he can run and play to his heart’s content.

NAME: Dolly
TEXT: Dolly is a charming girl, she likes meeting new people. She is very cuddly and affectionate. She comes when called and plays with toys. She is a good mixture of a hound that wants to go for a walk and be social with also wanting to lounge around doing nothing.

NAME: Matey
TEXT: *I have just aced my 8 weeks of foster care and I'm ready to go home with you!* Foster Update: "Matey is going great, enjoys his walks, enrichment toys and especially enjoys food! He now comes inside and runs straight to his bed and lies down, without me even needing to tell him, we are blown away with how well he is going!" Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and gentle, curious and affectionate nature, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey is an enthusiastic, gentle, smart and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a laid back yet playful friend. Matey suits full-time workers, and would enjoy a small yard to call his own. This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Oakley
TEXT: Oakley is an energetic and fun loving greyhound, he thrives when given structured activities. His ideal owner will love all of his drive, energy and passion for all things fun. His best fit would be an owner who is eager to actively train and work with him. He is a driven hound driven who loves physical and mental stimulation. His perfect match will be someone looking for a highly trainable and driven dog who enjoys training as much as he does. He has a strong need for physical and mental stimulation. His recall is excellent, he performs 'down' on cue, and he has the ability to walk nicely in heel position after exercise. He loves the outdoors and would do best as an outside dog. He is available now from our Western Sydney centre.

NAME: Sully
TEXT: *I have been in a foster care home for 6 weeks - read the update below!* "Sully is going well and has settled in and shows signs of improvement almost everyday. He is very good with children and with all types of dogs. He loves a walk and is good on the lead. On the lead he is well behaved and does not respond when other dog are walking near him. If I stop and talk with another dog walker Sully is calm and relates appropriately with other dogs. He gets on well will our daughters two kelpies that are staying with us for few weeks. The three dogs are happy to stay outside almost all day, the Kelpies have a crate they can come in and out of at night and Sully sleeps inside. Sully loves to drive in the car and enjoys the wind in his face as he keeps his head out of the window. He loves a cuddle and pat in the morning and anytime during the day if he is awake." ------------ Hi, I'm Sully, a gentle, quiet natured blue boy looking for my new home. I get along great with other dogs and don’t mind spending time in the yard while you’re out – but I do love having the freedom to go in and out as I please. I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and take in the fresh air throughout the day. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river (see photos)! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. When I first started going on walks, I wasn’t sure what to do, but with some patience and encouragement, I’ve learned to keep going and haven’t had any issues in a long time! Now, I just take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I have even learnt to walk up and down stairs! I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in, but I thrive best in a home where I still get plenty of interaction throughout the day. I love being around my people and enjoy a good balance of companionship and independence. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Hawke
TEXT: Hawke is a playful and happy boy 🐶, full of energy and confidence. He loves toys, gets excited easily, and brings joy wherever he goes! With a safe and slow introduction, Hawke has the potential to become best friends with your smaller dogs and even cats. He’s also great around young children, making him a fun and loving addition to a lively family. ❤️

NAME: Amber
TEXT: Amber is a gentle soul who may be a little shy at first 🐶, but with a warm and comforting home, she begins to shine. She blossoms with patience, support, and love ❤️, and would thrive best in a calm, peaceful environment. Older, understanding children would be a great match for her, helping her feel safe and supported as she builds confidence and truly comes into her own.

NAME: Jed
TEXT: Jed is a very handsome boy 🐶 with a playful spirit and a heart full of charm. He’s interactive and social, always ready to make new friends and spread good vibes. Confident yet a little goofy, Jed is easygoing and happy-go-lucky — the kind of companion who makes every moment more fun and lighthearted. ❤️

NAME: Queenie
TEXT: Queenie is a confident and loving soul 💖, radiating warmth wherever she goes. Her friendly, outgoing nature 🐾 makes her a joy to be around, and she thrives in social settings. Playful and engaging, Queenie brings happiness to every room she enters, leaving a lasting impression with her vibrant personality and boundless affection 🥰.

NAME: Axel
TEXT: Axel is a sweet and sensitive greyhound who’s looking for a home where he can continue to build his confidence and thrive with a little guidance. While he’s not overly timid, he does best in a home that offers clear structure, routine, and patient support as he navigates the world. Axel is affectionate and eager to please, and once he settles in, he becomes a calm and loyal companion. He enjoys the company of other greyhounds and could do well with a confident dog buddy to help him feel at ease. Axel is best suited to a quieter household without young kids, where he can relax and grow at his own pace. With a supportive environment and consistent routine, Axel has all the right ingredients to become a happy, well-adjusted family member.

NAME: Pocket
TEXT: Foster Notes: "She is really lovely, very affectionate and loves meeting new people. She hasn’t shown any signs of resource guarding or sleep startle, and she is very happy to snooze most of the day away." This little Pocket of sunshine is full of energy and fun! She's playful, hilarious and goofy, and will definitely make you laugh with her antics! Known for her cuddles, we love her here at the centre as she will snuggle right into you for a cuddle when you crouch down. She is very outgoing and affectionate, and we know someone will just love her for her silly cute personality. Pocket would prefer to be the only dog in her new home as she will thrive off all the love from her new family. She has shown she can do longer hours left alone indoors and would be perfect for full time workers looking for an affectionate dog. Due to her wiggly, bouncy nature we'd recommend older children in the home. This adorable, affectionate girl is known for her love of toys and fun loving personality. Pocket is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Naomi
TEXT: Naomi is a sweet & shy girl. She is suitable to live with other dogs including small dogs! Although initially shy, she is a brave girl who warms up well with consistent, gentle handling. Naomi would enjoy a quiet home with a grassy courtyard/backyard. She likes to keep to herself but travels well and is working on her confidence every day. If you're looking for a sweet and gentle hound who you can watch thrive with your nurturing personality, consider adopting Naomi. Naomi is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chief
TEXT: Meet Chief – a handsome, easy-going boy with a heart of gold. This laid-back fella is happy entertaining himself or just chillin' solo 😎. Patient and gentle, Chief is great with small children and gets along well with other animals. He grew up around a cattle dog and has been exposed to goats, so farm life is nothing new to him. Whether he's playing or relaxing in the sun, Chief brings a calm, loyal energy to any home 🐾.

NAME: Pete
TEXT: For Pete's sake, look at this handsome boy! Pete is a shy and reseved boy looking for a calm, low stimulus home to enjoy his retirement. Pete would do best without children and would love a backyard to retreat to when things get too busy for him. Pete is a delight around other greyhounds and gains confidence around them. A nurturing and relaxed owner would suit him the best. We think he would love to either live with another greyhound and/or continue socialisation around other dogs. Pete is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lloyd
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Lloyd! 💙 Lloyd may be a little shy when meeting new people, but with a supportive and understanding family, he quickly blossoms into a confident, happy, and loving boy. 🐶 Smart and full of potential, Lloyd is just waiting for the right people to help him shine. If you're looking for a sweet companion who’ll grow into your best buddy, Lloyd is ready to meet you! 💫

NAME: Flow
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Flow! 🌸 Flow is a very sweet girl with a heart full of potential. 💕 She's ready to learn, grow, and succeed with the help of a loving, supportive home. With a little training and plenty of encouragement, she’ll blossom into an amazing companion. She’d do best with older, understanding children and could be a great match for a calm, medium-large dog friend. If you're looking for a kind soul to grow with, Flow is ready to start her journey with you! 🐶💫

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jasper! 💙 Jasper is an affectionate, sweet, and kind-hearted boy who just wants to be loved. 🐶 He’s playful and gentle, with so much potential to shine in the right home. He’s still learning and will need a supportive family to continue his training and help build his confidence. Jasper would do best with older, understanding children and could get along well with a compatible medium-large dog. If you're ready to open your heart to a truly lovable companion, Jasper is waiting for you! 💕

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Reggie! 🐶 Reggie is an active, playful, and seriously handsome boy! 😍 He's full of energy and would love a yard where he can run, play, and burn off that puppy spirit. Still working on his manners, Reggie needs a patient, understanding family ready to guide him with love and consistency. He’d do best with older kids and could be a great match for a friendly medium-large dog buddy. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion to grow with, Reggie’s your guy! 💙

NAME: Emma
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Emma! 💖 Emma is a gentle soul with so much love to give. She may be a little shy at first, but with patience and kindness, her sweet personality shines through. 💕 She’s looking for a calm, supportive family to help her grow in confidence with continued training and socialisation. Emma enjoys the company of well-mannered dogs (especially larger ones!) and would do best with older, understanding children. A secure yard to play and explore would be the cherry on top for this lovely girl. 🐶🌿

NAME: Jodie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jodie! 💕 Jodie is a sweet, goofy girl with a big heart and an even bigger personality! 💖 She’s bursting with playful energy and would love a yard where she can zoom around and enjoy all her favorite games. Jodie is still learning the ropes, so she’ll need a patient, loving home committed to helping her grow with consistent training and gentle guidance. 🐶 She’d thrive with older, understanding kids and could do well with a medium-large dog friend who matches her vibe. If you’re ready to laugh, play, and love a little extra every day—Jodie’s your girl! 💕

NAME: Benson
TEXT: Meet Benson – A Gentle Giant with a Heart Full of Love 💙🐾 Benson is a sweet, kind-hearted boy who’s still finding his way in the world. This gentle giant is looking for a calm, supportive home where he can grow in confidence, surrounded by patience, understanding, and lots of love. He’ll need ongoing training and encouragement, but with the right guidance, Benson will blossom into the most loyal companion. He’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are calm and respectful, and would do best with older, understanding children who can give him the space and gentleness he needs. If you have a little extra room in your home—and your heart—Benson might just be the perfect fit. 💛

NAME: Ducky
TEXT: Meet Ducky – A Sweet, Gentle Soul Ready for Her Cozy Forever Home 🐾💗 Ducky is a loving, affectionate older girl who’s all about the cuddles and calm vibes. She’s looking for a slower-paced home where she can enjoy the quiet life with people who appreciate the beauty of a relaxed routine. Ducky would love a family with older, understanding children, and she’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are respectful and calm like her. If you're after a sweet companion who just wants to be loved and lounge by your side, Ducky might be your perfect match 🐾💗

NAME: Goofy
TEXT: Meet Goofy – A Special Boy Looking for His Special Home 🐶💛 Goofy is a sweet male with a quirky charm and a heart ready to bond. He’s looking for a quiet, patient home where he can take things at his own pace. Goofy needs someone who understands that dogs like him need time, gentle guidance, and a whole lot of love to build trust. He’s still learning about the world, so training and socialization will be key to helping him grow into his best self. Goofy would do best as the only dog in the home, with older, understanding children who can respect his boundaries. With the right people, Goofy will shine – could that be you?

NAME: Sofia
TEXT: Meet Sofia – A Loving Blue Beauty Looking for Her Forever Home 💙🐾 Sofia is a beautiful blue female with a gentle soul and a heart full of potential. She's looking for a home that can offer her support, understanding, and time—someone patient and committed to helping her grow with continued training and care. Sofia has an old injury to her front leg, so she’ll need a family that understands her physical needs and can help her feel safe and comfortable. She thrives best as a single dog in the household and would be happiest with older, dog-savvy children who can respect her space and needs. If you’re ready to offer a calm, loving home where Sofia can continue her journey, she’s ready to meet you. 💙

NAME: Felix
TEXT: Felix is a chilled-out charmer who’s just happy to be part of the fun. He’s quiet, calm, and has a super relaxed nature—nothing really bothers him! Whether it's hanging out with other dogs or being around kids, Felix fits right in. He’s friendly, gentle, and goes with the flow. This sweet boy doesn’t have a care in the world—he’s just looking for a comfy spot, some love, and maybe a snack or two. Felix is the kind of dog who brings a little bit of sunshine into every day without ever asking for much in return. If you’re after a gentle, low-fuss companion who gets along with everyone, Felix might just be your perfect match. 🐾💙

NAME: Tylah
TEXT: Tylah is a beautiful, gentle soul who’s mastered the art of relaxing. She’s a laid-back lady who loves her naps and cozy spots, but don’t let that fool you—she still has her zoomie moments! Short bursts of energy are her specialty, followed by lots of lounging and cuddles. She’s happiest when she’s with her people, always close by and ready to share her calm, loving presence. Loyal, sweet, and full of quiet charm, Tylah is the kind of companion who makes every day feel a little more peaceful. If you're looking for a loyal, low-maintenance best friend who will love being by your side (especially on the couch), Tylah might just be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Digger
TEXT: Digger is a curious, affectionate boy who loves to learn and be involved in whatever you're doing. He’s attentive, enjoys playing with his toys, and thrives on interaction. Digger would do best as the only dog in the home and would love having older children to play and bond with.

NAME: Brad
TEXT: Brad is a lively, energetic boy once he feels at home. He enjoys playtime, especially in a backyard where he can stretch his legs and have fun. Brad is good with smaller dogs and would do well in a home with older children. A sweet, active companion ready for his next adventure!

NAME: Rafiki
TEXT: Rafiki is a lively, energetic boy with an incredible love for toys! He’s a one-dog fetch machine—happily tossing his own toys just to chase them down again. Social, interactive, and full of fun, Rafiki brings playful energy and joy wherever he goes.

NAME: Dempsey
TEXT: Dempsey is a fun-loving, affectionate boy with a big personality and an even bigger love for his toys. He's interactive, silly, and always ready to make you laugh with his goofy antics. Dempsey does well with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction. A joyful companion who’s all about play, cuddles, and good vibes!

NAME: Zazu
TEXT: Zazu is a gentle male who takes a little time to settle in, but once he's comfortable, his playful and funny personality shines through. He absolutely loves his toys and enjoys exploring his surroundings with curiosity. Zazu gets along well with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction. A sweet soul with a goofy side, he’s sure to bring joy and laughter to a patient and loving home.

NAME: Rockstar
TEXT: Rockstar is the coolest, most laid-back guy around! Just like his name, he’s a chilled-out rockstar who loves attention and enjoys hanging out with people—especially kids. He’s great with all dogs and loves to play, making him the perfect companion for a fun-loving household. Rockstar is as friendly as they come and always ready to be part of the action. If you’re looking for a relaxed, happy, and playful buddy who’s always ready for some fun, Rockstar is your guy!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet Bruce! 🖤 Bruce is a sweet, laid-back boy with a charming personality. He gets along well with small dogs and is always happy to spend time with his human friends. Bruce does have pannus, a condition that affects his eyes. While it's not curable, it’s easily managed with treatment to keep him comfortable. If you’re looking for a friendly, easy-going companion with a big heart, Bruce is ready to bring his charm into your life!

NAME: Sonny
TEXT: Sonny is a strong, happy, and fun-loving boy who adores people and loves to play! He’s always up for some fun with his favorite toys—he absolutely loves them and could play all day. Sonny gets along great with medium to large breed dogs and would be happiest with a female dog friend. He’d also love to have a yard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. If you’re looking for an energetic and toy-obsessed companion with a heart full of love, Sonny might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Venus is a beautiful, independent lady who is an absolute delight to have around. She’s perfectly happy relaxing on her own but still enjoys some attention and pats when you're nearby. She’s been socialised with small dogs and, while she’s not overly interested in them, she’s calm and well-behaved in their company. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance companion who enjoys both quiet time and a little love, Venus could be the one for you! She may be nearly 8 years old but she still has lots of love to share.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a handsome, happy, and playful boy who’s full of personality! He loves life and enjoys being around people and other dogs—especially other greyhounds. Bob is strong and can get a little overexcited around small dogs, so he’d do best in a home without them. He would love to live with a medium to large female dog, or he’d be just as happy as the only dog in the home. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion with a big heart and a beautiful brindle coat, Bob could be your perfect match!

NAME: Rowdy
TEXT: Meet Rowdy! The handsome social butterfly with a heart full of love and a nose for treats! This confident and friendly guy absolutely adores people and will charm his way into your heart (and maybe your snack stash) in no time. Rowdy is super trainable and eager to learn, especially if food or toys are involved – a home that is interested in furthering his training and development is ideal Rowdy is still learning the ropes when it comes to other animals, so he’s best suited as a solo dog or with another greyhound friend who can help him find his groove. He’d thrive in a home with a yard to explore and a family who can support him through his transition to pet life. With a little guidance and a lot of love, Rowdy will be the ultimate loyal companion – cheeky, charming, and full of fun. Rowdy is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet this laid-back, placid boy—our sweet male Blaze! He's the definition of a "dopey" cuddle bug who loves nothing more than a good snuggle. As a single dog household pup, he's very content with his quiet life in the backyard, and he's happy to share his space with older children who understand his calm nature. Experienced owners will appreciate his lazy demeanor and gentle temperament. He’s all about relaxing and enjoying the simple things in life!

NAME: Sam (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Looking for a fun-loving, people-obsessed companion? Sam the greyhound is your guy! 🐾 With his playful personality and endless enthusiasm, he’s ready to steal your heart and bring joy to every adventure. Sam is a total people pleaser, always eager for his human's attention and affection. He’s incredibly social and loves to be around his people, making him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a friendly, outgoing dog. Sam is also pro when it comes to car rides—he loves hopping in for a fun adventure and travels like a champ. Whether it’s exploring new environments or playing with his favorite toys, Sam is always up for the next exciting thing! He’s also a big fan of walks, where his playful, excitable personality shines. Sam is suitbale for living with other dogs around his size and would also be happy to share his home with older kids. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and energetic pup to share your life with, Sam is your guy! 🐕💙 Contact the Western Sydney team to meet Sam today!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a playful, cheeky, and energetic female greyhound who loves people and is very social. She’s curious and full of fun, always ready for an adventure. With the right introduction, she might get along with smaller dogs, making her a great addition to an active and engaging home.

NAME: Collie
TEXT: Collie is a sweet older female with a calm, relaxed, and easy-going nature. She’s happy to please and would thrive in a slower-paced home. Older children are best for her, and she’s fine with smaller dogs and cats, making her a wonderful companion for a peaceful and loving household.

NAME: Dare
TEXT: Dare is a big, gentle giant with a very sweet and playful nature. He’s fun-loving yet shows a patient and calm side when needed. Confident and happy, Dare is the perfect mix of energy and tranquility, making him an affectionate companion for any home.

NAME: Windy
TEXT: Windy is a very sweet-natured male dog who can be a little shy at first but quickly comes out of his shell, especially when playing with toys. Confident on his own, he gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is sure to bring joy and warmth once he settles in.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: Hank is a calm, easy-going, and very friendly dog with an affectionate and interactive nature. He loves to connect with others and is great with smaller breeds of dogs. Hank’s gentle personality makes him a wonderful companion for any home looking for a sweet and sociable pet.

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a happy boy who thrives on his own in a single-dog household. He needs a supportive home where he can grow and learn. With patience and encouragement, Tom will blossom into a loving and confident companion.

NAME: Scotch
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Scotch! 🖤 Scotch is a happy, confident greyhound with a heart full of joy. Due to a past leg injury, he enjoys a slower-paced home and shorter walks—but don’t worry, he can still move around and play just fine! 🐾 Engaging, affectionate, and full of love, Scotch thrives in a calm environment where he can relax and enjoy life at his own pace. If you're looking for a gentle, loyal companion, Scotch is ready to win your heart. 💕

NAME: Uno
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Uno! 🌟 Uno is a lovely older lady with a confident, engaging personality and a heart full of love. 💕 She’s sweet, kind, and always happy—bringing a warm, joyful presence wherever she goes. With her calm nature and affectionate spirit, Uno makes the perfect companion for a caring, loving family ready to share their home with a gentle soul. 🐶💫 If you’re looking for a steady, loving friend, Uno is ready to make your heart her home.

NAME: Dozer
TEXT: Dozer, or "Little D," is a sweet boy who needs time and patience to learn and grow. He’ll thrive in a quiet home where he can feel safe and supported as he blossoms into his best self. With the right care, he’s sure to become a loving companion.

NAME: Milo
TEXT: Milo is a fun-loving male greyhound with a playful and confident personality. He’s happy, sweet-natured, and kind, making him a loving companion for any home. Milo’s cheerful attitude and affectionate nature are sure to bring joy to those around him.

NAME: Lexi
TEXT: Lexi is a sweet and placid female greyhound with a calm demeanor. Eager to learn, she needs room to grow and thrive, along with patience and understanding. A single-dog household would be ideal, providing her with the space and care she needs to flourish.

NAME: Aggi
TEXT: Aggi is a pretty female greyhound who can be a little shy at first. She needs encouragement, support, love, and time to grow. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can feel secure and receive the attention she needs. Aggi is eager to learn and thrive with the right care and patience.

NAME: Micha
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Micha! 💖 Micha is a sweet and sensitive female greyhound looking for a calm, loving home to help her blossom. With the right support and encouragement, she’s eager to learn and grow into a confident companion. She’ll thrive in a quiet environment where she feels safe and secure. Micha would do best as the only dog to start with, giving her the space and attention she needs to adjust and build trust. If you have a gentle heart and a peaceful home, Micha is ready to find comfort by your side. 🐶💕

NAME: Tubby
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Tubby! 💗 Tubby is a sweet girl who just needs a little time and patience to truly shine. 🌸 She can be a bit unsure at times, but with the right support and encouragement, she’ll blossom into a loving, confident companion. She’d do best in a calm, single-dog household where she can feel safe and truly be herself. With your love and guidance, Tubby is sure to thrive. 🐶💕

NAME: Sassy
TEXT: Sassy is a female greyhound looking for a quiet, supportive, and loving home. She needs room to grow, learn, and thrive, along with the encouragement and patience to help her blossom. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can receive all the attention and care she deserves.

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is a sweet female greyhound who can be a little shy and unsure at first, but she’ll open up with time and patience. She needs space, encouragement, and room to grow in a supportive environment. Molly thrives in a single-dog household where she can receive the love and attention she needs to feel comfortable and secure.

NAME: Minni
TEXT: Minni is a laid-back, easy-going older gal with a calm and confident demeanor. She’s curious and independent, but also affectionate and loves a good snuggle. Minni is the perfect companion for someone looking for a relaxed and loving pet.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Lucy is a very friendly and affectionate older girl who loves to give and receive cuddles. She can be relaxed and easy-going, but also has a cheeky, playful side that adds fun to her personality. Good with smaller breeds of dogs, Lucy makes a sweet and loving companion for any home.

NAME: Banj
TEXT: Banj is a sweet, older female greyhound, ready to enjoy a relaxing retirement. She’s calm, easy-going, and laid-back, thriving in a peaceful home. Banj gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is comfortable around older children, making her the perfect companion for a quiet, loving household.

NAME: Snoz
TEXT: Snoz is a male greyhound with a calm and quiet demeanor. He’s patient, easy-going, and always happy, enjoying a laid-back lifestyle. With his gentle nature, he’s the perfect companion for anyone seeking a relaxed and peaceful pet. Snoz is happy to make any M/L four-legged canine his best play and can't wait to have some cuddles with his new forever family. He would suit a household with full time workers, children to play with and would be very happy to live in an apartment.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Meet Bella, a sweet, kind, and patient female greyhound who remains calm in new environments. She’s excited to play and learn, always eager for new experiences. Bella is affectionate and loves to spend time with her humans, and she gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs. She’s ready to bring her gentle spirit and enthusiasm for life to a loving home!

NAME: Nova
TEXT: Meet Nova, a beautiful and sweet female greyhound who will melt your heart once she settles into her new home. She’s affectionate and loves cuddles, and she has a playful side when it comes to toys! Nova is patient and eager to learn, making her a wonderful companion for a family who can help her continue to grow. She’s ready to share her love and brighten your life!

NAME: Bec
TEXT: Meet Bec, a playful and affectionate female greyhound who absolutely loves toys! She enjoys collecting and playing with them, and there's nothing better than a cuddle and some quality time with her humans. Bec thrives in a home with an experienced owner who can provide her with the care and attention she needs, including a backyard to run and explore. She’s grown up around children, but older kids are best for her. She’s ready to bring love and joy into a forever home!

NAME: Zac
TEXT: Meet this gentle and shy male greyhound, looking for a loving, supportive family to help him continue to grow and thrive. With a quiet nature, he enjoys the simple pleasures of life, like collecting little toys, and he responds beautifully to a gentle touch. Having grown up around small children, he’s well-suited for a family environment. An experienced dog owner would be ideal, as he’s looking for someone who can provide the patience and care he needs to flourish.

NAME: Tony
TEXT: Tony is a barrel full of laughs, love & fun! This big goof ball loves to run, play & chase. He is an active boy with a spirit to match! He would love to find a home with older active children he can run around with in the backyard. Potentially another grey or large breed of dog to play with as well. He is a confident boy who doesn't shy away from much. Tony is ready to find his perfect family! Reach out to meet him today!

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Beautiful Lucy is lady who needs to find a supportive, patient & kind family. Lucy shows interest in wanting to be a part of a family, grow, learn how to be confident & playful, she just needs that support & encouragement to do so. A quiet home at first would be ideal. Lucy has spent time indoors, around children & a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction & supervision, Lucy may become best friends with your smaller fluff's, even your feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet Lucy :)

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Sweet Missy is a darling girl looking for her perfect family. Missy is looking for love & support from her new family in order for her shine and grow into the best version of herself. A quiet & patient home would be best. With growth, she will shine in personality & playfulness. Missy responds well to young children. She has spent time living indoors with a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction, Missy might become best friends with your small pups or feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet her :)

NAME: Red
TEXT: This is our boy Red. Say hello to this charming boy who is looking for his forever home. Red is relaxed on lead, great to handle, making your daily walks very enjoyable. He has had frequent exposure to leisurely strolls in town and enjoys the slow paced lifestyle. He is very friendly and will stop for pats or to say hello. At times Red can be apprehensive in new environments. Once he has found his feet, he takes the world in his stride and settles into a happy pace of life. He would suit a quieter home with any humans, big or small, that are willing to give him all of the love in the world.

NAME: Enzo
TEXT: Enzo is the perfect blend of calm, playful, goofy and loving. He enjoys spending time in the office and although he tolerates the chaos of the office, he ideally would prefer a calm and quiet lifestyle. A home with a backyard in a quieter area would be best for this boy and pending a meet and greet, a home with another medium to large dog could work for him too! He has loved playing with all of his Greyhound friends and is super social with all the people he meets when he's out and about. When he is left alone, he has shown to settle quite well so could suit a home where his humans are home less often throughout the day. This adorable boy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Stacey
TEXT: Meet our sweet girl Stacey. Stacey warms up after a little bit of attention but initially she could be weary of her surroundings. She has spent time around children and is gentle around them. Stacey is responsive on lead but will like to sniff around as well.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Are you after a playful and cheeky friend? Benji is after his forever home! He is all things cheeky, confident and cunning. Benji is responsive on lead but some extra training wouldn't go astray. He loves a pat and to bound around a yard big or small, he would be suitable to live in a townhouse or villa and would in time be able to conquer stairs. Benji had an injury in 2023 which he has now recovered from but has a plate in his hock. If you're interested in learning more about Benji, please apply now.

NAME: Jax (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Jax! This handsome boy is ready to find his forever home - Greeting you with a happy wagging tail and affectionate energy, Jax is sure to win over your heart in no time! Jax has had the pleasure of spending time with whippets, kids, and has been in a loving house setting, so he's already on his way to being well-versed in being a great family companion. Jax is looking for a forever family where he can offer endless affection and share his happy, friendly demeanour. If you're looking for a sweet companion to join your family, Jax might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Meet Jimmy, a laid-back and easygoing dog with a heart full of love to give. Jimmy is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a relaxed and unflustered canine friend. Jimmy is dog who adores the simple pleasures in life, from leisurely strolls in the park to quiet evenings lounging at home. He's not one to rush through life but rather takes his time to soak in his surroundings, making every moment feel special and serene. His chilled-out nature also makes him an excellent companion for other medium to large breed dogs. If you're in search of a dog who can seamlessly integrate into a tranquil lifestyle, whether you're single, a couple, or a family, Jimmy is ready to settle in and share his companionship with you. Get ready for leisurely adventures and cozy evenings with this loving and relaxed furry friend.

NAME: Paddy
TEXT: Mr Paddy! This gentle giant is such an easy-going, laid-back goof ball! He is always down to clown or just take it easy and rest his feet. He gets on well with smaller breeds of dogs- there's a Yorkie always saying hello :) Paddy interacts positively with new people, even younger children. He would love to have yard where he can run about, chasing toys thrown by his new best friends :)

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear, the ultimate embodiment of relaxation and tranquility wrapped up in a big, huggable package. This calm and easygoing canine companion resembles a giant teddy bear. Bear's favourite pastime is napping. Whether it's a lazy afternoon snooze on the patio or stretching out for a long, cozy rest beside you on the couch, Bear knows how to unwind like no other. While he might not be the most active pup on the block, Bear’s delightful charm lies in his serene nature. He's the perfect partner for a quiet afternoon reading session or watching a movie at home. Bear also enjoys a short walk around the block where he can have a sniff and explore Bear would thrive in a home where he can enjoy a relaxed lifestyle. While he may be big in size, his heart and loveable nature are even bigger.

NAME: Dora
TEXT: Pleased to introduce you to the wonderful Dora! Dora is a senior lady looking to share her love with a new family. Dora has spent time living with a young family for approx 12 months & is now ready to find her forever home. She loves young children. Very patient & calm with them. Dora is gentle, kind & affectionate. Engaging in sweet cuddles & kisses. Dora may adapt to living on her own or in an apartment. Confident & content, she might well adapt to full-time workers as well :)

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Looking for a sweetheart that loves children, engaging in fun play & snuggling? Then Millie is the girl for you! Millie is very excitable & playful! Loves to run around being a little silly & cheeky. Quick to jump in a body of water.... even on picture day hehe :)

NAME: Storm
TEXT: Relaxed & very loving older lady. Has spent time around grandchiildren. Storm is a confident girl looking for a life of leisure. She will do well on her own, with full time workers..... or if you might consider welcoming 2 beautiful ladies into your life, Storm’s sister, Chucky is also available :)

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Pattie
TEXT: Meet Pattie, a gentle and gracious senior who has spent her life expertly spreading love and warmth. Pattie has been in the company of children and copes well with if they are polite and well mannered. Pattie is a well-mannered lady who carries herself with a polite serenity, she has been socialised with small dogs and although she would prefer a large companion she is polite around small dogs. Pattie has slowed in her senior years, but she would love a foster home where she can settle and would be the perfect companion for someone looking for an older calm companion.

NAME: Eve
TEXT: Meet Eve, a gentle and calm senior lady who's ready to grace your home with her presence. With her quiet and serene nature, Eve is the epitome of tranquility, and she effortlessly brings a sense of peace wherever she roams. Eve has a friendly disposition and a soulful gaze that speaks volumes. She's an observant girl who appreciates the simpler things in life, making her a suitable match for a loving individual or family seeking a mellow furry friend. As a senior dog, Eve would thrive in a foster home where she can enjoy her golden years in comfort. Her dream environment would be one filled with love, where she can relax while being treasured as the devoted companion she is.
